/* === HERMES LIVE/SIM GATE PATCH (toggle button controls real trades) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const POLICY = safeReadJSON(path.join(ROOT, "config", "policy.json"), {
      minLiveScoreAbs: 3, minSimScoreAbs: 2
    });

    // On garde un pointeur vers l'ancienne fct si besoin
    const __old_onCandleClose = (typeof onCandleClose === "function") ? onCandleClose : null;

    // Remplace le handler de clôture de bougie (15s)
    onCandleClose = function(instId, candle){
      try{
        setHealth("strategy", { lastCandle: Date.now() });

        // Récupère l'historique 15s déjà accumulé
        const hist = MARKET.candles[instId]?.getHistory() || [];
        if (hist.length < 30) return; // pas assez d'historique pour scorer

        // Score identique à ta logique actuelle
        const { score, dir } = computeScore(hist);

        // 1) SIM toujours ON: on loggue le signal pour l'apprentissage
        appendJSONL(AI.simLogsFile, {
          ts: tsISO(), event:"SIM_SIGNAL", instId, dir, score, px:candle.c
        });
        try{
          broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"SIM_SIGNAL", instId, side:dir, score, price:candle.c, live:false });
        }catch{}

        // 2) Gate LIVE vs SIM selon le bouton (AI.on) + seuils dédiés
        const live = !!AI.on; // == bouton ON/OFF
        const minAbs = live ? Math.abs(POLICY.minLiveScoreAbs||3) : Math.abs(POLICY.minSimScoreAbs||2);

        if (!dir || Math.abs(score) < minAbs){
          // pas assez fort -> on peut pousser en file si tu veux
          return;
        }

        // 3) LIVE: si bouton ON + creds valides -> ordonner, sinon juste file d'attente
        if (live && OKX.KEY && OKX.SECRET && OKX.PASS){
          if (canPlaceOrder(instId, dir)){
            placeMarket(instId, dir);
            // Note: placeMarket loggue TRADE_ENTER uniquement si OKX accepte l'ordre
          } else {
            pushPendingSignal(instId, dir, score);
          }
        } else {
          // Bouton OFF => pas d'ordre réel, on garde juste les signaux pour l'entraînement
          pushPendingSignal(instId, dir, score);
        }

        // Mise à jour des stops dynamiques si une position est ouverte sur ce symbole
        if (AI.openPositions[instId]) updateDynamicStop(instId);
      }catch(e){
        log("[ONCANDLECLOSE_ERR]", instId, e.message);
      }
    };

    // Log d'info au démarrage du patch
    log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE] Patch actif | minLiveScoreAbs=", POLICY.minLiveScoreAbs, "| minSimScoreAbs=", POLICY.minSimScoreAbs);

  }catch(e){
    log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END PATCH === */
/* === HERMES LOGS NORMALIZER (backend payloads) === */
(() => {
  try{
    function prettySymbol(instId){
      try{
        if(!instId) return "";
        const s = String(instId).toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-");
        const p = s.split("-");
        if (p.length>=3 && p[2]==="SWAP") return `${p[0]}/${p[1]}`;
        if (p.length>=2) return `${p[0]}/${p[1]}`;
        return s;
      }catch{return String(instId||"");}
    }

    // 1) WS privé: trace login explicite (INFO)
    try{
      if (MARKET && MARKET.wsPrivate) {
        MARKET.wsPrivate.on("message", (raw)=>{
          try{
            const msg = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (msg.event === "login") {
              log("[WS_PRIVATE_LOGIN]", "code:", msg.code, "msg:", msg.msg || msg.message || "");
              broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`WS Privé login code=${msg.code} ${msg.msg||msg.message||""}`, live:true });
            }
          }catch{}
        });
      }
    }catch{}

    // 2) Wrapper rejets d'ordres → INFO lisible
    function logOrderReject(tag, res){
      try{
        const code  = (res?.data && res.data[0] && (res.data[0].sCode ?? res.code)) ?? res?.code ?? "NA";
        const msg   = (res?.data && res.data[0] && (res.data[0].sMsg  ?? res.msg )) ?? res?.msg  ?? "unknown";
        log("[ORDER_REJECT]", tag, "=>", code, msg);
        broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Refus OKX (${code}) ${msg}`, live:true });
      }catch{}
    }
    globalThis.__logOrderReject = logOrderReject; // dispo dans placeMarket patch

    // 3) Enrichir TRADE_ENTER/EXIT avec leverage & symbol lisible
    const __old_placeMarket = placeMarket;
    placeMarket = async function(instId, side){
      const s = positionSizing(AI.equityUSDT);
      const px = MARKET.tick[instId]?.lastPrice || 0;
      const qty = qtyFromUSDT(instId, s.perTradeUSDT);
      if (px<=0 || qty<=0) return { ok:false, reason:"noPriceOrQty" };

      const port = await loadPortfolio().catch(()=>null);
      const availableUSDT = num(port?.balances?.details?.find(d=>String(d.ccy).toUpperCase()==="USDT")?.availBal || 0);
      if (!canPlaceOrder(instId, side, availableUSDT)) return { ok:false, reason:"cannotPlace" };

      try{
        AI.inflight++; setHealth("orders", { inflight:AI.inflight });
        await okxPOST("/api/v5/account/set-leverage",{ instId, lever:String(DEFAULT_LEVERAGE), mgnMode:"isolated", posSide:side });

        const res = await okxPOST("/api/v5/trade/order",{
          instId, tdMode:"isolated", side: side==='long' ? "buy" : "sell",
          ordType:"market", sz:String(qty), posSide: side, clOrdId: "HERMES-" + Date.now(),
        });

        const okCode   = (res && (res.code === "0" || res.code === 0));
        const okData   = (res?.data && res.data[0] && (res.data[0].sCode === "0" || res.data[0].sCode === 0 || res.data[0].ordId));
        const accepted = okCode || okData;
        if (!accepted){ __logOrderReject?.("placeMarket", res); throw new Error("OKX reject"); }

        AI.counters.ordersPlaced++; setHealth("orders", { placed:AI.counters.ordersPlaced, status:"OK", info:"placed" });

        // position record
        if (!AI.openPositions[instId]) AI.openPositions[instId] = { side, qty, avgPx:px, ts:now() };
        AI.openPositions[instId].marginAtEntry = (px*qty*(MARKET.meta[instId]?.ctVal||1)) / (DEFAULT_LEVERAGE||20);

        // stop initial
        const stp = await placeInitialStop(instId, side, px, qty);
        if (stp.ok){ AI.openPositions[instId].stopId = stp.algoId; AI.openPositions[instId].stopPx = stp.stopPx; AI.openPositions[instId].stopMode="INIT"; }

        // TRADE_ENTER avec infos enrichies
        const sym = prettySymbol(instId);
        broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"TRADE_ENTER", instId, symbol:sym, side, qty, price:px, lev:DEFAULT_LEVERAGE, live:true });
        logAIEvent({ event:"TRADE_ENTER", instId, side, qty, price:px, lev:DEFAULT_LEVERAGE, live:true });

        return { ok:true, res };
      }catch(e){
        if (String(e.message||"")!=="OKX reject"){
          AI.counters.orderErrors++; setHealth("orders", { errors:AI.counters.orderErrors, status:"WARN", info:"place error" });
          log("[ORDER_ERR]", instId, side, e.message);
        }
        return { ok:false, error:e.message };
      }finally{
        AI.inflight = Math.max(0, AI.inflight-1); setHealth("orders", { inflight:AI.inflight });
      }
    };

    // 4) TRADE_EXIT enrichi → PNL net si dispo
    const __old_wsPrivateMsg = (MARKET?.wsPrivate && MARKET.wsPrivate.listeners("message")?.[0]) || null;
    // (On garde la logique existante d'update positions. Ici, on complète juste le broadcast)
    const __orig_onPrivateMessage = (raw) => {}; // no-op: on ne remplace pas, on reste sur existant

    // On hooke sur logAIEvent pour uniformiser EXIT
    const __old_logAIEvent = logAIEvent;
    logAIEvent = function(obj){
      try{
        if (obj && obj.event==="TRADE_EXIT"){
          obj.symbol = obj.symbol || prettySymbol(obj.instId||"");
          obj.lev = obj.lev || DEFAULT_LEVERAGE;
        }
      }catch{}
      return __old_logAIEvent(obj);
    };

  }catch(e){
    log("[LOGS_NORMALIZER_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END LOGS NORMALIZER === */
/* === HERMES PERSISTENCE & UPDATE WATCHERS (SAFE APPEND) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const fs = require("fs"), path = require("path");

    function dailyDealsFile(ts){ const d = new Date(ts||Date.now());
      const y=d.getUTCFullYear(), m=String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0"), dd=String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,"0");
      return path.join(DATADIR,"trades-logs",`deals_${y}${m}${dd}.jsonl`);
    }
    function persistDeal(deal){
      try{ fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DATADIR,"trades-logs"),{recursive:true});
        const f = dailyDealsFile(deal.time||Date.now());
        fs.appendFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(deal)+"\n");
      }catch(e){ log("[DEALS_PERSIST_ERR]", e.message); }
    }
    function loadDealsHistory(days=14, maxItems=500){
      try{
        const dir = path.join(DATADIR,"trades-logs");
        fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});
        const now = Date.now(), one = 86400000;
        const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(n=>/^deals_\d{8}\.jsonl$/.test(n)).sort().reverse();
        const keep = files.filter(n=>{
          try{
            const ymd = n.match(/deals_(\d{8})\.jsonl$/)[1];
            const y=ymd.slice(0,4), m=ymd.slice(4,6), d=ymd.slice(6,8);
            const ts = Date.UTC(+y, +m-1, +d);
            return (now - ts) <= days*one;
          }catch{return false;}
        });
        const acc = [];
        for(const f of keep){
          const lines = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,f),"utf8").trim().split("\n");
          for(const line of lines){ try{ acc.push(JSON.parse(line)); }catch{} }
          if (acc.length >= maxItems) break;
        }
        acc.sort((a,b)=> (b.time||0)-(a.time||0));
        DEALS.recent = acc.slice(0, maxItems);
      }catch(e){ log("[DEALS_LOAD_ERR]", e.message); }
    }

    // Hook TRADE_EXIT pour persister
    const __old_logAIEvent = logAIEvent;
    logAIEvent = function(obj){
      try{
        if (obj && obj.event==="TRADE_EXIT"){
          // normalise & persiste
          const deal = {
            time: Date.now(),
            symbol: obj.instId || obj.symbol || "",
            side:   String(obj.side||"").toUpperCase(),
            price:  obj.price,
            profit: obj.profit || obj.pnl || 0,
            leverage: obj.leverage || DEFAULT_LEVERAGE || 20,
            margin: obj.margin,
            notional: obj.notional
          };
          persistDeal(deal);
        }
      }catch(e){ log("[DEALS_HOOK_ERR]", e.message); }
      return __old_logAIEvent(obj);
    };

    // Recharger l'historique récent au boot (14 jours)
    try{ loadDealsHistory(14, 600); }catch{}

    // Watchers de mise à jour (policy / ai.config / model)
    function watchInfo(label, file){
      try{
        if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return;
        fs.watch(file, {persistent:false}, (_e,_f)=>{
          try{
            broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Mise à jour ${label} rechargée`, live:true });
          }catch{}
        });
      }catch{}
    }
    watchInfo("policy.json", path.join(ROOT,"config","policy.json"));
    watchInfo("ai.config.json", path.join(ROOT,"config","ai.config.json"));
    watchInfo("modèle (alpha.json)", path.join(DATADIR,"models","alpha.json"));

  }catch(e){ log("[PERSIST_PATCH_ERR]", e.message); }
})();
 /* === END PERSISTENCE & WATCHERS === */
/* === HERMES LIVE/SIM GATE (SAFE APPEND) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const POLICY = safeReadJSON(path.join(ROOT, "config", "policy.json"), {
      minLiveScoreAbs:3, minSimScoreAbs:2, cooldownLiveSec:10, cooldownSimSec:5
    });
    function prettySymbol(instId){
      try{ const s=String(instId||"").toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-"); const p=s.split("-"); return (p.length>=2)?`${p[0]}/${p[1]}`:s; }catch{return String(instId||"");}
    }
    const __old_placeMarket = placeMarket;
    placeMarket = async function(instId, side){
      const s = positionSizing(AI.equityUSDT);
      const px = MARKET.tick[instId]?.lastPrice || 0;
      const qty = qtyFromUSDT(instId, s.perTradeUSDT);
      if (px<=0 || qty<=0) return { ok:false, reason:"noPriceOrQty" };
      const port = await loadPortfolio().catch(()=>null);
      const availableUSDT = num(port?.balances?.details?.find(d=>String(d.ccy).toUpperCase()==="USDT")?.availBal || 0);
      if (!canPlaceOrder(instId, side, availableUSDT)) return { ok:false, reason:"cannotPlace" };
      try{
        AI.inflight++; setHealth("orders", { inflight:AI.inflight });
        await okxPOST("/api/v5/account/set-leverage",{ instId, lever:String(DEFAULT_LEVERAGE), mgnMode:"isolated", posSide:side });
        const res = await okxPOST("/api/v5/trade/order",{ instId, tdMode:"isolated", side: side==='long' ? "buy" : "sell", ordType:"market", sz:String(qty), posSide: side, clOrdId: "HERMES-"+Date.now() });
        const ok = (res && (res.code=="0"||res.code===0)) || (res?.data && res.data[0] && (res.data[0].sCode=="0"||res.data[0].sCode===0||res.data[0].ordId));
        if (!ok){ try{const code=res?.data?.[0]?.sCode??res?.code, msg=res?.data?.[0]?.sMsg??res?.msg; broadcastAILog({ ts:tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Refus OKX (${code}) ${msg}`, live:true }); }catch{}; throw new Error("OKX reject"); }
        AI.counters.ordersPlaced++; setHealth("orders", { placed:AI.counters.ordersPlaced, status:"OK", info:"placed" });
        if (!AI.openPositions[instId]) AI.openPositions[instId] = { side, qty, avgPx:px, ts:now() };
        AI.openPositions[instId].marginAtEntry = (px*qty*(MARKET.meta[instId]?.ctVal||1))/(DEFAULT_LEVERAGE||20);
        const stp = await placeInitialStop(instId, side, px, qty);
        if (stp.ok){ AI.openPositions[instId].stopId=stp.algoId; AI.openPositions[instId].stopPx=stp.stopPx; AI.openPositions[instId].stopMode="INIT"; }
        broadcastAILog({ ts:tsISO(), event:"TRADE_ENTER", instId, symbol:prettySymbol(instId), side, qty, price:px, lev:DEFAULT_LEVERAGE, live:true });
        logAIEvent({ event:"TRADE_ENTER", instId, side, qty, price:px, lev:DEFAULT_LEVERAGE, live:true });
        setCooldown(instId, AI.on ? (POLICY.cooldownLiveSec||10) : (POLICY.cooldownSimSec||5));
        return { ok:true, res };
      }catch(e){
        if (String(e.message||"")!=="OKX reject"){ AI.counters.orderErrors++; setHealth("orders", { errors:AI.counters.orderErrors, status:"WARN", info:"place error" }); log("[ORDER_ERR]", instId, side, e.message); }
        return { ok:false, error:e.message };
      }finally{ AI.inflight=Math.max(0,AI.inflight-1); setHealth("orders",{inflight:AI.inflight}); }
    };

    const __old_onCandleClose = (typeof onCandleClose==="function")?onCandleClose:null;
    onCandleClose = function(instId, candle){
      try{
        setHealth("strategy",{lastCandle:Date.now()});
        const hist = MARKET.candles[instId]?.getHistory()||[]; if (hist.length<30) return;
        const { score, dir } = computeScore(hist);
        appendJSONL(AI.simLogsFile, { ts:tsISO(), event:"SIM_SIGNAL", instId, dir, score, px:candle.c });
        try{ broadcastAILog({ ts:tsISO(), event:"SIM_SIGNAL", instId, side:dir, score, price:candle.c, live:false }); }catch{}
        const live=!!AI.on; const minAbs = live?Math.abs((safeReadJSON(path.join(ROOT,"config","policy.json"),{}).minLiveScoreAbs)||3):Math.abs((safeReadJSON(path.join(ROOT,"config","policy.json"),{}).minSimScoreAbs)||2);
        if (!dir || Math.abs(score)<minAbs) return;
        if (live && OKX.KEY && OKX.SECRET && OKX.PASS){ if (canPlaceOrder(instId, dir)) placeMarket(instId, dir); else pushPendingSignal(instId, dir, score); }
        else { pushPendingSignal(instId, dir, score); }
        if (AI.openPositions[instId]) updateDynamicStop(instId);
      }catch(e){ log("[ONCLOSE_ERR]", instId, e.message); }
    };

    const __orig_logAIEvent = logAIEvent;
    logAIEvent = function(obj){
      if (obj && obj.event==="AI_TOGGLE"){
        try{ broadcastAILog({ ts:tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${obj.on===true?"Activée":"Désactivée"}`, live:true }); }catch{}
      }
      return __orig_logAIEvent(obj);
    };
    log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE] actif");
  }catch(e){ log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE_ERR]", e.message); }
})();
 /* === END GATE === */
/* === HERMES LOG NORMALIZER (broadcast layer) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const __orig_broadcastAILog = broadcastAILog;
    broadcastAILog = function(payload){
      try{
        let p = payload;

        // 1) si c'est une chaîne brute → transformer en INFO
        if (typeof p === "string"){
          if (p === "AI_TOGGLE"){
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}`, live:true };
          } else {
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:String(p), live:true };
          }
        }

        // 2) si c'est un objet AI_TOGGLE → transformer en INFO
        if (p && p.event === "AI_TOGGLE"){
          p = { ts: p.ts || tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}`, live:true };
        }

        // 3) pas d'étiquette AI-LIVE/AI-SIMU pour INFO côté UI (le formateur s'en charge)
        __orig_broadcastAILog(p);
      }catch{
        // en cas d'erreur, on diffuse quand même l'original
        __orig_broadcastAILog(payload);
      }
    };
    log("[LOG_NORMALIZER] broadcastAILog normalisé (AI_TOGGLE -> INFO).");
  }catch(e){
    log("[LOG_NORMALIZER_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END === */
/* === HERMES: broadcast normalizer v2 (INFO sans live + anti-doublons) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const __orig_broadcastAILog = broadcastAILog;
    const __dedupe = { last:"", at:0 };

    broadcastAILog = function(payload){
      try{
        let p = payload;

        // 1) String brute -> INFO
        if (typeof p === "string"){
          if (p === "AI_TOGGLE"){
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
          } else {
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:String(p) };
          }
        }

        // 2) AI_TOGGLE objet -> INFO
        if (p && p.event === "AI_TOGGLE"){
          p = { ts: p.ts || tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
        }

        // 3) Tous les INFO n’ont PAS de p.live (pour éviter tout préfixe [AI-LIVE])
        if (p && p.event === "INFO"){
          try{ delete p.live; }catch{}
          // anti-doublons 2s
          const key = `[INFO] ${p.info||""}`;
          const now = Date.now();
          if (__dedupe.last === key && (now - __dedupe.at) < 2000) return;
          __dedupe.last = key; __dedupe.at = now;
        }

        __orig_broadcastAILog(p);
      }catch{
        __orig_broadcastAILog(payload);
      }
    };

    log("[LOG_NORMALIZER_V2] INFO sans live + dédoublonnage actif.");
  }catch(e){
    log("[LOG_NORMALIZER_V2_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END === */
/* === HERMES: broadcast normalizer v3 (INFO & TRAINER_TICK sans live) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const __orig_broadcastAILog = broadcastAILog;
    const __dedupe = { last:"", at:0 };

    function toInfo(obj, defMsg){
      const msg = obj?.info || defMsg || "";
      return { ts: obj?.ts || tsISO(), event: "INFO", info: String(msg) };
    }

    broadcastAILog = function(payload){
      try{
        let p = payload;

        // String brutes => INFO
        if (typeof p === "string"){
          if (p === "AI_TOGGLE"){
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
          } else {
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:String(p) };
          }
        }

        // AI_TOGGLE objet => INFO
        if (p && p.event === "AI_TOGGLE"){
          p = { ts: p.ts || tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
        }

        // TRAINER_TICK => transformer en INFO (pour éviter tout tag AI-SIM)
        if (p && p.event === "TRAINER_TICK"){
          const samples = (p.samples!=null)? ` (samples ${p.samples})` : "";
          p = toInfo(p, `Mise à jour modèle${samples}`);
        }

        // Tous les INFO => supprimer le champ 'live' pour empêcher tout préfixe AI-*
        if (p && p.event === "INFO"){
          try{ delete p.live; }catch{}
          // anti-doublons 2s
          const key = `[INFO] ${p.info||""}`;
          const now = Date.now();
          if (__dedupe.last === key && (now - __dedupe.at) < 2000) return;
          __dedupe.last = key; __dedupe.at = now;
        }

        __orig_broadcastAILog(p);
      }catch{
        __orig_broadcastAILog(payload);
      }
    };

    log("[LOG_NORMALIZER_V3] INFO & TRAINER_TICK diffusés sans 'live'.");
  }catch(e){
    log("[LOG_NORMALIZER_V3_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END === */
/* === HERMES: broadcast guard v4 (drop empty INFO, strong dedupe) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const __orig_broadcast = broadcastAILog;
    const __seen = { key:"", at:0 };

    function isBlank(s){ return !s || !String(s).trim().length; }

    broadcastAILog = function(payload){
      try{
        let p = payload;

        // Normalisation minimale
        if (typeof p === "string"){
          if (p === "AI_TOGGLE"){
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
          } else {
            p = { ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:String(p) };
          }
        }

        // AI_TOGGLE objet -> INFO
        if (p && p.event === "AI_TOGGLE"){
          p = { ts: p.ts || tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
        }

        // TRAINER_TICK -> INFO lisible
        if (p && p.event === "TRAINER_TICK"){
          const samples = (p.samples!=null)? ` (samples ${p.samples})` : "";
          p = { ts: p.ts || tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Mise à jour modèle${samples}` };
        }

        // BLOQUE: INFO vide => on ne diffuse pas
        if (p && p.event === "INFO"){
          // retirer toute étiquette "live" éventuelle
          try{ delete p.live; }catch{}
          if (isBlank(p.info)) return; // <-- coupe ici si vide

          // anti-doublons plus fort (5s)
          const key = `[INFO] ${p.info.trim()}`;
          const now = Date.now();
          if (__seen.key === key && (now - __seen.at) < 5000) return;
          __seen.key = key; __seen.at = now;
        }

        __orig_broadcast(p);
      }catch{
        __orig_broadcast(payload);
      }
    };

    log("[LOG_GUARD_V4] INFO vides filtrés + dédoublonnage 5s.");
  }catch(e){ log("[LOG_GUARD_V4_ERR]", e.message); }
})();
 /* === END === */
/* === HERMES: PERSISTENCE & WATCHERS (safe) === */
(() => {
  try{
    const fs = require("fs");

    // fichier du jour pour archiver les deals
    function dailyDealsFile(ts){
      const d = new Date(ts || Date.now());
      const y = d.getUTCFullYear();
      const m = String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0");
      const dd= String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,"0");
      return path.join(DATADIR, "trades-logs", `deals_${y}${m}${dd}.jsonl`);
    }

    // écrire un deal dans le fichier du jour
    function persistDeal(deal){
      try{
        const dir = path.join(DATADIR,"trades-logs");
        try{ fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); } catch {}
        const f = dailyDealsFile(deal.time || Date.now());
        fs.appendFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(deal) + "\n");
      }catch(e){ log("[DEALS_PERSIST_ERR]", e.message); }
    }

    // charger l’historique récent dans DEALS.recent (reboot-safe)
    function loadDealsHistory(days=14, maxItems=600){
      try{
        const dir = path.join(DATADIR,"trades-logs");
        try{ fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); } catch {}
        const now = Date.now();
        const one = 86400000;
        const files = fs.readdirSync(dir)
          .filter(n => /^deals_\d{8}\.jsonl$/i.test(n))
          .sort()
          .reverse();

        const keep = files.filter(n => {
          try{
            const ymd = n.match(/deals_(\d{8})\.jsonl$/i)[1];
            const y = +ymd.slice(0,4), m = +ymd.slice(4,6), d = +ymd.slice(6,8);
            const ts = Date.UTC(y, m-1, d);
            return (now - ts) <= days*one;
          }catch{ return false; }
        });

        const acc = [];
        for (const fname of keep){
          try{
            const txt = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,fname), "utf8").trim();
            if (!txt) continue;
            const lines = txt.split("\n");
            for (const line of lines){
              try{ acc.push(JSON.parse(line)); } catch {}
              if (acc.length >= maxItems) break;
            }
            if (acc.length >= maxItems) break;
          }catch{}
        }
        acc.sort((a,b)=> (b.time||0) - (a.time||0));
        try{ DEALS.recent = acc.slice(0, maxItems); } catch {}
      }catch(e){ log("[DEALS_LOAD_ERR]", e.message); }
    }

    // Hook TRADE_EXIT -> persister le deal
    const __persist_prev_logAIEvent = logAIEvent;
    logAIEvent = function(obj){
      try{
        if (obj && obj.event === "TRADE_EXIT"){
          const deal = {
            time:   Date.now(),
            symbol: obj.instId || obj.symbol || "",
            side:   String(obj.side||"").toUpperCase(),
            price:  obj.price,
            profit: obj.profit || obj.pnl || 0,
            leverage: obj.leverage || DEFAULT_LEVERAGE || 20,
            margin: obj.margin,
            notional: obj.notional
          };
          persistDeal(deal);
        }
      }catch(e){ log("[DEALS_HOOK_ERR]", e.message); }
      return __persist_prev_logAIEvent(obj);
    };

    // Recharger l’historique au boot (14 jours, 600 entrées max)
    try{ loadDealsHistory(14, 600); } catch {}

    // Watchers: quand ces fichiers changent -> pousser un INFO
    function watchReload(label, targetFile){
      try{
        const dir  = path.dirname(targetFile);
        const base = path.basename(targetFile).toLowerCase();
        try{ fs.mkdirSync(dir, {recursive:true}); } catch {}
        // On surveille le dossier pour ne pas planter si le fichier n'existe pas encore
        fs.watch(dir, { persistent:false }, (evt, fname) => {
          try{
            if (!fname) return;
            if (String(fname).toLowerCase() !== base) return;
            broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info: `${label} mis à jour` });
          }catch{}
        });
      }catch(e){ log("[WATCH_ERR]", label, e.message); }
    }

    watchReload("policy.json",       path.join(ROOT,"config","policy.json"));
    watchReload("ai.config.json",    path.join(ROOT,"config","ai.config.json"));
    watchReload("modèle (alpha.json)", path.join(DATADIR,"models","alpha.json"));

    log("[PERSIST_DEALS] actif");
  }catch(e){
    log("[PERSIST_INIT_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END PERSISTENCE & WATCHERS === */
/* === HERMES: LIVE/SIM Gate V2 + OKX accept + BE/Trail policy === */
(() => {
  // évite double installation
  if (globalThis.__HERMES_GATE_V2) { try{ log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE] déjà installé"); }catch{} return; }
  globalThis.__HERMES_GATE_V2 = true;

  try{
    const path = require("path");
    const POLICY = safeReadJSON(path.join(ROOT,"config","policy.json"), {
      slInitPctOfMargin: -0.40,
      beNetPctOfMargin:   0.25,
      trailOnNetPctOfMargin: 0.40,
      trailCallbackRatio: 0.003,
      cooldownLiveSec: 10,
      cooldownSimSec:  5,
      minLiveScoreAbs: 3,
      minSimScoreAbs:  2
    });

    function prettySymbol(instId){
      try{ const s=String(instId||"").toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-"); const p=s.split("-"); return (p.length>=2)?`${p[0]}/${p[1]}`:s; }catch{return String(instId||"");}
    }
    function ctVal(instId){ return num(MARKET.meta[instId]?.ctVal || 1); }
    function marginAt(entryPx, qty, instId, lev){
      const ct = ctVal(instId); const notional = entryPx * qty * ct; return (lev>0? notional/lev : notional);
    }
    function profitUSDT(instId, side, entryPx, lastPx, qty){
      const ct = ctVal(instId);
      return (side==='long' ? (lastPx-entryPx) : (entryPx-lastPx)) * qty * ct;
    }
    function feeTaker(){
      const f = (typeof MARKET.fees?.taker === "number") ? MARKET.fees.taker : 0.0005;
      return Math.max(0, f);
    }
    function stopPxFromMargin(instId, side, entryPx, qty, pctOfMargin){
      const ct = ctVal(instId);
      const lev = DEFAULT_LEVERAGE || 20;
      const notional = entryPx*qty*ct;
      const margin  = lev ? (notional/lev) : notional;
      const dUSDT   = (pctOfMargin||0) * margin;            // +/- USDT visé
      const dPx     = dUSDT / (qty*ct);                     // variation de prix équivalente
      return side==='long' ? (entryPx + dPx) : (entryPx - dPx);
    }

    /* ---- 1) placeInitialStop conforme policy (SL ≈ marge * -40%) ---- */
    const __old_placeInitialStop = (typeof placeInitialStop==="function")?placeInitialStop:null;
    placeInitialStop = async function(instId, side, entryPx){
      try{
        const s = positionSizing(AI.equityUSDT);
        const qty = qtyFromUSDT(instId, s.perTradeUSDT);
        if (qty<=0) return { ok:false, reason:"noQty" };
        const stopPx = stopPxFromMargin(instId, side, entryPx, qty, POLICY.slInitPctOfMargin || -0.40);

        const body = {
          instId, tdMode:"isolated", posSide: side,
          side: side==='long' ? "sell" : "buy",
          ordType:"trigger",
          triggerPx: String(stopPx),
          slTriggerPxType: (OKX_CFG.trading?.triggerPxType)||"mark"
        };
        const r = await okxPOST("/api/v5/trade/order-algo", body);
        if (r?.data?.[0]?.algoId){
          AI.counters.stopsPlaced++; setHealth("stops",{ placed:AI.counters.stopsPlaced, status:"OK", info:"placed" });
          return { ok:true, algoId:r.data[0].algoId, stopPx };
        }
        return { ok:false, r };
      }catch(e){
        setHealth("stops",{ status:"WARN", info:"placeInitialStop error" });
        log("[STOP_INIT_ERR]", instId, e.message);
        return { ok:false, error:e.message };
      }
    };

    /* ---- 2) placeMarket: check acceptation OKX + tag live + cooldown ---- */
    const __old_placeMarket = (typeof placeMarket==="function")?placeMarket:null;
    placeMarket = async function(instId, side){
      const s  = positionSizing(AI.equityUSDT);
      const px = MARKET.tick[instId]?.lastPrice || 0;
      const qty= qtyFromUSDT(instId, s.perTradeUSDT);
      if (px<=0 || qty<=0) return { ok:false, reason:"noPriceOrQty" };

      const port = await loadPortfolio().catch(()=>null);
      const availableUSDT = num(port?.balances?.details?.find(d=>String(d.ccy).toUpperCase()==="USDT")?.availBal || 0);
      if (!canPlaceOrder(instId, side, availableUSDT)) return { ok:false, reason:"cannotPlace" };

      try{
        AI.inflight++; setHealth("orders",{ inflight:AI.inflight });

        await okxPOST("/api/v5/account/set-leverage",{
          instId, lever:String(DEFAULT_LEVERAGE), mgnMode:"isolated", posSide:side
        });

        const res = await okxPOST("/api/v5/trade/order",{
          instId, tdMode:"isolated",
          side: side==='long' ? "buy" : "sell",
          ordType:"market",
          sz:String(qty),
          posSide: side,
          clOrdId: "HERMES-"+Date.now()
        });

        // acceptation OKX ?
        const ok = (res && (res.code=="0"||res.code===0))
                || (res?.data && res.data[0] && (res.data[0].sCode=="0"||res.data[0].sCode===0||res.data[0].ordId));
        if (!ok){
          try{
            const code=res?.data?.[0]?.sCode??res?.code, msg=res?.data?.[0]?.sMsg??res?.msg;
            broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Refus OKX (${code}) ${msg}` });
          }catch{}
          throw new Error("OKX reject");
        }

        AI.counters.ordersPlaced++; setHealth("orders",{ placed:AI.counters.ordersPlaced, status:"OK", info:"placed" });

        const lev = DEFAULT_LEVERAGE || 20;
        const mgn = marginAt(px, qty, instId, lev);
        if (!AI.openPositions[instId]) AI.openPositions[instId] = { side, qty, avgPx:px, ts:Date.now() };
        AI.openPositions[instId].marginAtEntry = mgn;

        const stp = await placeInitialStop(instId, side, px);
        if (stp.ok){ AI.openPositions[instId].stopId = stp.algoId; AI.openPositions[instId].stopPx = stp.stopPx; AI.openPositions[instId].stopMode="INIT"; }

        // trailing natif armé ; le lock 25% est géré par updateDynamicStop (ci‑dessous)
        placeTrailing(instId, side, px).catch(()=>{});

        broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"TRADE_ENTER", instId, symbol: prettySymbol(instId), side, qty, price:px, lev:lev, live: !!AI.on });
        logAIEvent({ event:"TRADE_ENTER", instId, side, qty, price:px, leverage:lev, live:true });

        const cd = !!AI.on ? (POLICY.cooldownLiveSec||10) : (POLICY.cooldownSimSec||5);
        setCooldown(instId, cd);

        return { ok:true, res };
      }catch(e){
        if (String(e.message||"")!=="OKX reject"){
          AI.counters.orderErrors++; setHealth("orders",{ errors:AI.counters.orderErrors, status:"WARN", info:"place error" });
          log("[ORDER_ERR]", instId, side, e.message);
        }
        return { ok:false, error:e.message };
      }finally{
        AI.inflight = Math.max(0, AI.inflight-1);
        setHealth("orders",{ inflight:AI.inflight });
      }
    };

    /* ---- 3) onCandleClose: seuils score & gate LIVE/SIM ---- */
    const __old_onCandleClose = (typeof onCandleClose==="function")?onCandleClose:null;
    onCandleClose = function(instId, candle){
      try{
        setHealth("strategy",{lastCandle:Date.now()});
        const hist = MARKET.candles[instId]?.getHistory() || [];
        if (hist.length < 30) return;
        const { score, dir } = computeScore(hist);

        // SIM log (non affiché en UI)
        appendJSONL(AI.simLogsFile, { ts: tsISO(), event:"SIM_SIGNAL", instId, dir, score, px:candle.c });

        const live   = !!AI.on;
        const minAbs = live ? Math.abs(POLICY.minLiveScoreAbs||3) : Math.abs(POLICY.minSimScoreAbs||2);
        if (!dir || Math.abs(score) < minAbs) return;

        if (live && OKX.KEY && OKX.SECRET && OKX.PASS){
          if (canPlaceOrder(instId, dir)) placeMarket(instId, dir);
          else pushPendingSignal(instId, dir, score);
        } else {
          pushPendingSignal(instId, dir, score);
        }

        if (AI.openPositions[instId]) updateDynamicStop(instId);
      }catch(e){ log("[ONCLOSE_ERR]", instId, e.message); }
    };

    /* ---- 4) updateDynamicStop: BE +25% (net) & TRAIL ON +40% (lock +25%) ---- */
    const __old_updateDynamicStop = (typeof updateDynamicStop==="function")?updateDynamicStop:null;
    updateDynamicStop = async function(instId){
      try{
        const pos = AI.openPositions[instId]; if (!pos) return;
        const last = MARKET.tick[instId]?.lastPrice || 0; if (!last || !pos.avgPx) return;
        const qty  = Math.abs(pos.qty||0); if (!qty) return;

        const lev  = DEFAULT_LEVERAGE || 20;
        const ct   = ctVal(instId);
        const notional = pos.avgPx * qty * ct;
        const margin   = pos.marginAtEntry || (lev ? (notional/lev) : notional);

        const pnl     = profitUSDT(instId, pos.side, pos.avgPx, last, qty);
        const fees    = (feeTaker() * notional * 2); // entrée + sortie
        const pnlNet  = pnl - fees;

        const beUSDT    = (POLICY.beNetPctOfMargin || 0.25) * margin;
        const trailUSDT = (POLICY.trailOnNetPctOfMargin || 0.40) * margin;

        // BE net 0 (approx) -> stop = entry +/- (25% marge)
        if (pnlNet >= beUSDT && (!pos.stopMode || pos.stopMode==="INIT")){
          const newStop = stopPxFromMargin(instId, pos.side, pos.avgPx, qty, Math.max(0.0, (POLICY.beNetPctOfMargin||0.25)));
          pos.stopMode = "BE";
          pos.stopPx   = newStop;
          broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"STOP_BE_NET0", instId, symbol: prettySymbol(instId), side: pos.side, price: newStop, live: !!AI.on });
          logAIEvent({ event:"STOP_BE", instId, newStop, pnlUSDT: pnlNet, live:true });
          return;
        }

        // TRAIL ON à +40% net -> lock +25%
        if (pnlNet >= trailUSDT){
          const lock25 = stopPxFromMargin(instId, pos.side, pos.avgPx, qty, Math.max(0.0, (POLICY.beNetPctOfMargin||0.25)));
          if (!pos.stopMode || pos.stopMode!=="TRAIL" || (pos.side==='long' ? lock25>pos.stopPx : lock25<pos.stopPx)){
            pos.stopMode = "TRAIL";
            pos.stopPx   = lock25;
            broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"TRAIL_ON_LOCK25", instId, symbol: prettySymbol(instId), side: pos.side, price: lock25, live: !!AI.on });
            logAIEvent({ event:"STOP_TRAIL", instId, newStop: lock25, last, pnlUSDT: pnlNet, live:true });
          } else {
            // si déjà trail, rehausse possible
            const newLock = lock25;
            if (pos.side==='long' ? newLock>pos.stopPx : newLock<pos.stopPx){
              pos.stopPx = newLock;
              broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"TRAIL_RAISE_LOCK25", instId, symbol: prettySymbol(instId), side: pos.side, price: newLock, live: !!AI.on });
            }
          }
          return;
        }
      }catch(e){ log("[STOP_UPDATE_ERR]", instId, e.message); }
      if (typeof __old_updateDynamicStop === "function"){ try{ return __old_updateDynamicStop(instId); }catch{} }
    };

    // AI_TOGGLE -> INFO lisible (pas de spam, géré par garde INFO côté log normalizer)
    const __orig_logAIEvent = logAIEvent;
    logAIEvent = function(obj){
      if (obj && obj.event==="AI_TOGGLE"){
        try{ broadcastAILog({ ts: tsISO(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${obj.on===true?"Activée":"Désactivée"}` }); }catch{}
      }
      return __orig_logAIEvent(obj);
    };

    log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE_V2] actif");
  }catch(e){
    log("[LIVE_SIM_GATE_V2_ERR]", e.message);
  }
})();
 /* === END: LIVE/SIM Gate V2 === */
/* === HERMES: broadcast guard V5 (no blank INFO, strip LIVE on INFO, dedupe) === */
(() => {
  if (globalThis.__HERMES_LOG_GUARD_V5) { try{ log("[LOG_GUARD_V5] déjà installé"); }catch{} return; }
  globalThis.__HERMES_LOG_GUARD_V5 = true;

  try{
    const __orig = broadcastAILog;
    const __infoCache = { key:"", at:0 };

    function nonEmpty(s){ return !!(s && String(s).trim().length); }

    broadcastAILog = function(payload){
      try{
        let p = payload;
        if (p == null) return;

        // Chaîne brute -> INFO
        if (typeof p === "string"){
          if (p === "AI_TOGGLE"){
            p = { ts: new Date().toISOString(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI?.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
          } else {
            p = { ts: new Date().toISOString(), event:"INFO", info:String(p) };
          }
        }

        // Si pas d'event mais info présente -> INFO
        if (!p.event && nonEmpty(p.info)) p.event = "INFO";

        // Convertir AI_TOGGLE "hérités" -> INFO lisible
        if (p.event === "AI_TOGGLE"){
          p = { ts: p.ts || new Date().toISOString(), event:"INFO", info:`Hermes – IA ${AI?.on===true ? "Activée" : "Désactivée"}` };
        }

        // Trainer -> INFO "Mise à jour modèle (samples N)"
        if (p.event === "TRAINER_TICK"){
          const n = (p.samples!=null) ? ` (samples ${p.samples})` : "";
          p = { ts: p.ts || new Date().toISOString(), event:"INFO", info:`Mise à jour modèle${n}` };
        }

        // Normalisation des INFO
        if (p.event === "INFO"){
          // pas de tag LIVE/SIM sur INFO
          try{ delete p.live; }catch{}
          // ignorer INFO vide
          if (!nonEmpty(p.info)) return;

          // dédoublonnage local (5s) sur le même texte
          const key = String(p.info).trim();
          const now = Date.now();
          if (__infoCache.key === key && (now - __infoCache.at) < 5000) return;
          __infoCache.key = key; __infoCache.at = now;
        }

        return __orig(p);
      }catch{
        try{ return __orig(payload); }catch{}
      }
    };

    try{ log("[LOG_GUARD_V5] actif"); }catch{}
  }catch(e){
    try{ log("[LOG_GUARD_V5_ERR]", e.message); }catch{}
  }
})();

/* __HERMES_SIM_FOLLOWER_V1__ */
(function(){
  try{
    if (globalThis.__HERMES_SIM_FOLLOWER_V1__) return;
    globalThis.__HERMES_SIM_FOLLOWER_V1__ = true;
    const fs = require("fs");
    const path = require("path");
    const simPaper = require(path.resolve(__dirname, "..", "modules", "sim_paper.js"));
    const DATA = (typeof DATADIR!=="undefined" ? DATADIR : path.join(__dirname,"data"));
    const logPath = (globalThis.AI && globalThis.AI.simLogsFile) ? globalThis.AI.simLogsFile : path.join(DATA, "sim-logs.jsonl");
    let offset = 0, buffer = "";
    function processChunk(chunk){
      buffer += chunk; let idx;
      while((idx = buffer.indexOf("\n")) >= 0){
        const line = buffer.slice(0, idx); buffer = buffer.slice(idx + 1);
        try { const o = JSON.parse(line); if (o && o.event === "SIM_SIGNAL") simPaper.onSimSignal(o); } catch {}
      }
    }
    function readNew(){
      try{
        const st = fs.statSync(logPath); if (st.size < offset) offset = 0;
        if (st.size > offset){
          const stream = fs.createReadStream(logPath, { start: offset, end: st.size - 1, encoding: "utf8" });
          stream.on("data", processChunk); stream.on("end", ()=>{ offset = st.size; });
        }
      }catch(e){}
    }
    // seed: rejouer N dernières lignes
    const seed = Number(process.env.HERMES_SIM_FOLLOW_SEED_TAIL || 2000);
    try{
      if (seed > 0 && fs.existsSync(logPath)){
        const lines = fs.readFileSync(logPath, "utf8").trim().split("\n");
        const start = Math.max(0, lines.length - seed);
        for (let i=start;i<lines.length;i++){
          try { const o = JSON.parse(lines[i]); if (o && o.event === "SIM_SIGNAL") simPaper.onSimSignal(o); } catch {}
        }
        try { offset = fs.statSync(logPath).size; } catch(e){ offset = 0; }
      } else { try { offset = fs.statSync(logPath).size; } catch(e){ offset = 0; }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    const period = Number(process.env.HERMES_SIM_FOLLOW_EVERY_MS || 3000);
    setInterval(readNew, period);
  }catch(e){ try { log("[SIM_FOLLOWER:init]", e.message) } catch {} }
})();

/* __HERMES_MODEL_WATCHER_V1__ */
(function(){
  try{
    const fs   = require('fs');
    const path = require('path');
    const DATA = (typeof DATADIR!=="undefined" ? DATADIR : path.join(__dirname,'data'));
    const modelPath = path.join(DATA,'models','alpha.json');

    let lastWeights = null;
    let lastStamp   = null;

    function readModelSafe(){
      try{
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(modelPath,'utf8');
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      }catch(e){ return null }
    }
    function sgn(x){ const n=Number(x||0); return (n>=0?'+':'')+Math.abs(n).toFixed(4) }
    function nowISO(){ try{ return (typeof tsISO==='function') ? tsISO() : new Date().toISOString(); }catch(_){ return new Date().toISOString() } }

    function onChange(){
      const A = readModelSafe(); if (!A) return;
      const P = A.pnlTraining || {};
      const W = A.weights || {};
      const curStamp = P.ts || A.updatedAt || null;

      // calc Δweights par rapport au dernier snapshot en mémoire
      const delta = {};
      if (lastWeights){
        Object.keys(W).forEach(k=>{
          const before = Number(lastWeights[k]||0), after = Number(W[k]||0);
          if (Number.isFinite(before) && Number.isFinite(after)){
            delta[k] = +(after - before).toFixed(4);
          }
        });
      }
      lastWeights = W; lastStamp = curStamp;

      // Ligne lisible pour les logs
      const samples = Number(P.samples||0);
      const mean    = (P.mean!==undefined && P.mean!==null) ? sgn(P.mean) : '?';
      const corr    = (P.corr && typeof P.corr.score==='number') ? P.corr.score.toFixed(4) : '?';
      const dLine   = Object.keys(delta).length ? (' | Δweights ' + Object.keys(delta).map(k=>`${k}:${delta[k]>=0?'+':''}${delta[k].toFixed(4)}`).join(' ')) : '';
      const info    = `[AI-TRAIN] samples ${samples} | mean ${mean} | corr(score) ${corr}${dLine}`;

      try {
        if (typeof broadcastAILog === 'function') {
          broadcastAILog({ ts: nowISO(), event:'INFO', info, live:false, _fmt:'TRAIN_STATUS' });
        }
      } catch(_e) {}
    }

    // Premier passage + watch sur le fichier modèle
    try { if (fs.existsSync(modelPath)) { onChange(); fs.watchFile(modelPath, { interval: 2000 }, onChange); } } catch(e){ try{ log('[MODEL_WATCHER]', e.message) }catch(_){} }
  } catch(e){ try{ log('[MODEL_WATCHER:init]', e.message) }catch(_){} }
})();

const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require("electron");
const allowedInvokes = new Set(["ui-auth","ui-mode","get-ai-state","fetch-data","fetch-portfolio","toggle-ai","place-order","get-health","debug-snapshot"]);
const allowedOn = new Set(["ai-log","health-tick"]);
contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld("api", {
  invoke: (channel, ...args) => {
    if (!allowedInvokes.has(channel)) return Promise.reject(new Error(`invoke non autorisé: ${channel}`));
    return ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, ...args);
  },
  on: (channel, listener) => {
    if (!allowedOn.has(channel)) return;
    const wrapped = (_event, ...data) => listener(...data);
    ipcRenderer.on(channel, wrapped);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener(channel, wrapped);
  },
});

  <script>
    // ===== Bridge IPC (Electron avec nodeIntegration ou preload) =====
    let ipcRenderer;
    try { ipcRenderer = require("electron").ipcRenderer; } catch { ipcRenderer = null; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.electron && window.electron.ipcRenderer){ ipcRenderer = window.electron.ipcRenderer; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.api && typeof window.api.invoke === "function"){
      ipcRenderer = { invoke: (...args) => window.api.invoke(...args), on: (ch, fn) => window.api.on(ch, fn) };
    }
    if(!ipcRenderer){ console.warn("Electron IPC non disponible (ni nodeIntegration ni preload bridge)."); }

    // ===== Helpers =====
    function formatSymbol(raw){
      if(!raw) return "";
      const s = String(raw).toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-");
      const parts = s.split("-");
      if (parts.length >= 3 && parts[2] === "SWAP") return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}-M`;
      if (parts.length >= 2) return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}`;
      return s;
    }
    function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)); }

    class HermesMonitor{
      constructor(){
        this.data = []; this.portfolioData = null;
        this.startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests = 0; this.successfulRequests = 0;
        this.portfolioRequests = 0; this.portfolioSuccessful = 0;
        this.spotChartCtx = null; this.resizeObserver = null;
        this.toggleBusy = false;
        this.init();
      }

      async init(){
        this.startTimeUpdater(); this.startUptimeUpdater();

        // Premiers fetchs
        await this.fetchData();
        await this.fetchPortfolio();
        await this.refreshAI();

        // Boucles de rafraîchissement
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchData(), 1000);
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchPortfolio(), 3000);
        setInterval(()=>this.refreshAI(), 3000);

        const c = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if (c) this.spotChartCtx = c.getContext("2d");
        this.setupResize();

        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
if (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
    if(this.isViewer || !ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.classList.add("busy");
    try{
      const cur = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      const next = !(cur && cur.active === true);
      await ipcRenderer.invoke("toggle-ai", next);
      const fresh = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      this.renderAI(fresh);
    }catch(e){
      try{
        const el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        if (el) {
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] Toggle: ${e?.message||e}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
          if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
        }
      }catch{}
    }finally{
      btn.classList.remove("busy");
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
}

        // Logs temps réel
if (ipcRenderer?.on) {
  ipcRenderer.on("ai-log", (_e, payload)=>{
    try{
      const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
      let msg;
      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
      if (payload === undefined || payload === null) {
        msg = "(no message)";
      } else if (typeof payload === "string") {
        msg = payload;
      } else {
        const mode = (payload && payload.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIM";
        const ev   = payload?.event ? String(payload.event).toUpperCase() : "LOG";
        const sym  = payload?.instId || "";
        const side = payload?.side ? String(payload.side).toUpperCase() : "";
        const qty  = (payload?.qty!=null) ? `x${payload.qty}` : "";
        const px   = (payload?.price!=null) ? `@ ${payload.price}` : "";
        msg = `[${mode}] [${ev}] ${sym} ${side} ${qty} ${px}`.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");
      }
      const node = document.createElement("div");
      node.className = "log-item";
      node.innerHTML = `<span>${msg}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
      el.prepend(node);
      if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
    }catch{}
  });
}

// Catch erreurs JS
        window.addEventListener("error", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] ${e.message}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
        window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_REJECT] ${e.reason?.message||e.reason||'Promise rejected'}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
      }

      setupResize(){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if(!canvas) return;
        const cb = ()=>{
          canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth; canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
          if (this.portfolioData?.history?.spot) this.drawSpotChart(this.portfolioData.history.spot);
        };
        this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(cb); this.resizeObserver.observe(canvas); cb();
      }

      async refreshAI(){
        try{
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
          const state = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
          this.renderAI(state);
        }catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
      }

      async fetchData(){
        const startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests++;
        try{
          this.updateStatus("loading","Synchronisation...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-data");
          const responseTime = Date.now()-startTime;
          if(result.success){
            this.successfulRequests++;
            this.updateStatus("connected","Connecté OKX");
            const arr = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data.slice(0, 100) : [];
            this.updateUI(arr, responseTime);
            const cc = document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if (cc) cc.textContent = String(arr.length);
          } else { throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-data failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updateStatus("error","Erreur de connexion");
          this.showError(err.message||String(err));
        }
      }

      async fetchPortfolio(){
        this.portfolioRequests++;
        try{
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("loading","Sync Portfolio...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-portfolio");
          if(result.success){
            this.portfolioSuccessful++;
            this.updatePortfolioStatus("connected","Portfolio OKX");
            this.updatePortfolioUI(result.data);
          }else{ throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-portfolio failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("error","Erreur Portfolio");
          console.error("Erreur Portfolio:", err);
        }
      }

      renderAI(state){
        const label = document.getElementById("aiStateLabel");
        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
        const logsEl = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        const active = !!(state && (state.active === true || state.active === "true"));
        if(label){ label.textContent = active ? "Actif" : "Inactif"; label.className = "ai-state " + (active ? "ai-active" : "ai-inactive"); }
        if(btn){ btn.className = "toggle-btn" + (active ? " active" : ""); }
        const html = (state?.logs||[]).slice(-150).reverse().map(l=>{
          const d = new Date(l.ts);
          return `<div class="log-item"><span>${l.message}</span><span>${d.toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
        if(logsEl && !logsEl.dataset.hydrated){
          logsEl.innerHTML = html || "<div class='log-item'><span>Aucun log</span><span>--:--:--</span></div>";
          logsEl.dataset.hydrated = "1";
        }
      }

      updateUI(data, responseTime){
        if(!data || !Array.isArray(data)) return;
        this.data = data; this.renderTable(); this.renderMovers();
        const cc=document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if(cc) cc.textContent=String(this.data.length);
        this.updateStats(responseTime);
      }

      updatePortfolioUI(p){
        if(!p) return; this.portfolioData = p;

        // N4 — Soldes
        const soldeCompte = Number(p.futures?.total ?? 0);
        const usedMargin  = Number(p.positions?.totalMargin ?? 0);
        const disponible  = Math.max(0, soldeCompte - usedMargin);

        document.getElementById("soldeCompte").textContent     = `$${this.formatPrice(soldeCompte)}`;
        document.getElementById("openTradesAmount").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;
        document.getElementById("availableBalance").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(disponible)}`;

        // N5 — Positions
        document.getElementById("openPositions").textContent = p.positions?.count ?? 0;
        document.getElementById("positionsValue").textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(p.positions?.totalValue ?? 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("totalMargin").textContent   = `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;

        const unrealizedPnLEl = document.getElementById("unrealizedPnL");
        const pnlValue = Number(p.futures?.unrealizedPnL || 0);
        unrealizedPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(pnlValue))}`;
        unrealizedPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${pnlValue >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N6 — Performance (+ rendement/min UI)
        const winrateEl = document.getElementById("winrate");
        const winrate = Number(p.performance?.winrate || 0);
        winrateEl.textContent = `${winrate.toFixed(1)}%`;
        winrateEl.className = `metric-value ${winrate >= 50 ? "positive" : winrate >= 30 ? "warning" : "negative"}`;

        const dailyPnLEl = document.getElementById("dailyPnL");
        const dailyPnL = Number(p.performance?.dailyPnL || 0);
        dailyPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(dailyPnL))}`;
        dailyPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${dailyPnL >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        const ypmEl = document.getElementById("yieldPerMin");
        const ypm = this.computeYieldPerMin(p.dealsRecent||[]);
        ypmEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(ypm)}/min`;
        ypmEl.className = `metric-value ${ypm >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N7 — Activité
        document.getElementById("dailyTrades").textContent = p.performance?.dailyTrades || 0;
        document.getElementById("dailyVolume").textContent = `$${this.formatVolume(p.performance?.dailyVolume || 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("lastUpdate").textContent  = new Date(p.lastUpdate||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

        // N5/N10/N9 — Rendus détaillés
        this.renderOpenTrades(p.openPositionsDetails || []);
        this.drawSpotChart(p.history?.spot || []);
        this.renderHistory(p.dealsRecent || []);
      }

      computeYieldPerMin(deals){
        if(!deals || !deals.length) return 0;
        const now = Date.now();
        const last60 = deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 60*60*1000);
        let sample = last60.length ? last60 : deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 24*60*60*1000);
        if(!sample.length) sample = deals;
        const pnl = sample.reduce((a,d)=> a + (Number(d.profit||d.pnl||0)||0), 0);
        const firstTs = Math.min(...sample.map(d=>Number(d.time||now)));
        const mins = Math.max(1, (now - firstTs) / 60000);
        return pnl / mins;
      }

      renderOpenTrades(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#openTradesTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' style='color:#888;'>Aucune position ouverte</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.entryTime || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
          const ur   = Number(r.unrealizedPnl ?? r.upl ?? 0);
          const pnlCls = ur>=0 ? "positive" : "negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${r.side==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${r.side}</span></td>
            <td>${r.leverage? "x"+Number(r.leverage): "-"}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.entryPrice)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(ur)}</td>
            <td>${time}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderHistory(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#historyTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' style='color:#888;'>Aucun trade</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0,300).map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.time||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          const pnl  = Number(r.profit||r.pnl||0);
          const pnlCls = (pnl>=0)?"positive":"negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${time}</td>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()}</span></td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.price)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin||0)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(pnl)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      drawSpotChart(points){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart");
        if(!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
        if(!points || points.length < 2) return;

        const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height, pad = 20;
        const xs = points.map(p=>p.t), ys = points.map(p=>Number(p.v||0));
        const minY = Math.min(...ys), maxY = Math.max(...ys);
        const yPad = (maxY-minY)*0.1 || 1;
        const lo = minY - yPad, hi = maxY + yPad;
        const t0 = xs[0], t1 = xs[xs.length-1] || (t0+1);
        const X = v => pad + ((v - t0) / (t1 - t0 || 1)) * (w - pad*2);
        const Y = v => h - pad - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (h - pad*2);

        // Bords
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f2f2f"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w-pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(w-pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();

        // Ligne
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a9eff";
        points.forEach((p,i)=>{ const x=X(p.t), y=Y(Number(p.v||0)); if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); });
        ctx.stroke();

        // Dernière valeur
        const last = points[points.length-1];
        let lx = Math.min(X(last.t)+6, w - pad - 110);
        let ly = Math.max(Y(Number(last.v||0))-6, pad + 14);
        const text = "$"+this.formatPrice(last.v);
        ctx.font = "12px Monaco, monospace";
        const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + 8, th = 16;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(lx-4, ly-12, tw, th);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#e8e8e8"; ctx.fillText(text, lx, ly);
      }

      renderTable(){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody"); if(!tableBody) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ tableBody.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='padding:12px;color:#b8b8b8;'>En attente de données...</div>"; return; }

        const rows = this.data.slice(0, 100);
        tableBody.innerHTML = rows.map((c, i)=>{
          const price = Number(c.lastPrice)||0;
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100);
          const cls = change>0?"positive":change<0?"negative":"neutral";

          const fundingNum = (typeof c.fundingRate === "number") ? c.fundingRate : null;
          const funding = (fundingNum===null) ? "—" : `${fundingNum>=0?"+":""}${(fundingNum*100).toFixed(4)}%`;
          const fundingCls = (fundingNum===null) ? "neutral" : (fundingNum>0?"positive":fundingNum<0?"negative":"neutral");

          const makerFee = (typeof c.makerFee === "number") ? (c.makerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.makerFee || "—");
          const takerFee = (typeof c.takerFee === "number") ? (c.takerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.takerFee || "—");

          const upd = new Date(c.updatedTs||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

          return `
            <div class="table-row">
              <div class="cell rank">${i+1}</div>
              <div class="cell symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</div>
              <div class="cell price ${cls}">$${this.formatPrice(price)}</div>
              <div class="cell change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(2):"0.00"}%</div>
              <div class="cell volume">${this.formatVolume(c.volume24)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.high24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.low24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell funding ${fundingCls}">${funding}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${makerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${takerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell trend-indicator">${upd}</div>
            </div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderMovers(){
        const moversList = document.getElementById("moversList"); if(!moversList) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ moversList.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='color:#888;'>—</div>"; return; }
        const topMovers = [...this.data].sort((a,b)=> Math.abs(+b.riseFallRate||0) - Math.abs(+a.riseFallRate||0)).slice(0,4);
        moversList.innerHTML = topMovers.map(c=>{
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100); const cls = change>=0?"positive":"negative";
          return `<div class="mover-item"><span class="mover-symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</span><span class="mover-change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(1):"0.0"}%</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      updateStats(responseTime){
        const lat = document.getElementById("latency"); if(lat) lat.textContent = `${responseTime}ms`;
        const sr = document.getElementById("successRate");
        const successRate = this.totalRequests ? (this.successfulRequests / this.totalRequests * 100).toFixed(0) : 0;
        if(sr) sr.textContent = `${successRate}%`;
      }

      updateStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("statusDot"), t = document.getElementById("statusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }
      updatePortfolioStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusDot"), t = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }

      startTimeUpdater(){ setInterval(()=>{ const el = document.getElementById("currentTime"); if(el) el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR"); },1000); }
      startUptimeUpdater(){
        setInterval(()=>{ const u = Date.now()-this.startTime; const h=Math.floor(u/3600000), m=Math.floor((u%3600000)/60000), s=Math.floor((u%60000)/1000);
          const el=document.getElementById("uptime"); if(el) el.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s).padStart(2,"0")}`; },1000);
      }

      showError(message){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
        if(tableBody) tableBody.innerHTML = `<div class="error" style="color:#f87171;text-align:center;padding:20px;">Erreur: ${message}</div>`;
      }

      formatPrice(price){
        const p = parseFloat(price); if(!isFinite(p)) return "0.00";
        if(p < 0.01) return p.toFixed(6);
        if(p < 1) return p.toFixed(4);
        if(p < 100) return p.toFixed(2);
        return p.toFixed(2);
      }
      formatVolume(v){
        const n = parseFloat(v); if(!isFinite(n)) return "0";
        if(n >= 1e9) return (n/1e9).toFixed(1)+"B";
        if(n >= 1e6) return (n/1e6).toFixed(1)+"M";
        if(n >= 1e3) return (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+"K";
        return n.toFixed(0);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ()=>{
      window.hermesMonitor = new HermesMonitor();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>


<!-- === HERMES LOG FORMATTER (append, robust) === -->
<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__hermesLogFormatterInstalled) return;
  window.__hermesLogFormatterInstalled = true;

  function human(n){
    var x = Number(n);
    if(!isFinite(x)) return (n==null?"":String(n));
    try { return x.toLocaleString("fr-FR",{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:6}); }
    catch { return String(x); }
  }

  function fmt(p){
    if (!p) return null;
    if (p.event === "SIM_SIGNAL") return null; // on masque la SIM brute
    if (p.event === "INFO") return "[INFO] " + (p.info||"");
    var tag = (p.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIMU";
    var sym = p.symbol || p.instId || "";
    var side= (p.side||"").toString().toUpperCase();
    var lev = p.lev ? (" x"+p.lev) : "";
    if (p.event === "TRADE_ENTER") return "["+tag+"] Ouverture "+sym+" – "+side+lev+(p.price!=null?(" – @ "+human(p.price)):"");
    if (p.event === "TRADE_EXIT")  return "["+tag+"] Fermeture "+sym+" – "+side+lev+(p.profit!=null?(" – PNL "+(p.profit>=0?"+":"")+human(p.profit)+" USDT"):"");
    if (p.event === "STOP_BE_NET0") return "["+tag+"] Stop BE (net) "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAIL_ON_LOCK25") return "["+tag+"] Trailing ON & lock +25% "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAIL_RAISE_LOCK25") return "["+tag+"] Trailing rehaussé "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "STOP_PLACED") return "["+tag+"] Stop initial "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAINER_TICK") return "[INFO] Mise à jour modèle"+(p.samples!=null?(" (samples "+p.samples+")"):"");
    if (p.event === "ORDER_REJECT" || p.event === "ORDER_ERR") return "[INFO] Refus/Erreur ordre "+sym+" – "+side+(p.reason?(" : "+p.reason):"");
    if (p.event === "AI_TOGGLE") return "[INFO] Hermes – IA "+(p.on===true?"Activée":"Désactivée");
    return null;
  }

  function getIPC(){
    try{
      // Préférence: bridge preload (window.api)
      if (window.api && typeof window.api.on === "function") {
        return { on: window.api.on.bind(window.api) };
      }
      // Fallback: variable globale ipcRenderer déjà créée dans index.html
      if (window.ipcRenderer && typeof window.ipcRenderer.on === "function") {
        return { on: function(ch, cb){ try{ window.ipcRenderer.on(ch, function(_e, payload){ cb(payload); }); }catch(e){} } };
      }
      // Fallback require('electron') si dispo
      if (typeof require === "function") {
        try{
          var electron = require("electron");
          if (electron && electron.ipcRenderer && typeof electron.ipcRenderer.on === "function") {
            return { on: function(ch, cb){ electron.ipcRenderer.on(ch, function(_e, payload){ cb(payload); }); } };
          }
        }catch(e){}
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  }

  function install(){
    var IPC = getIPC();
    var el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
    if (!IPC || !el) { setTimeout(install, 300); return; }

    var lastInfo = { msg:"", at:0 };
    IPC.on("ai-log", function(payload){
      try{
        var msg = fmt(payload);
        if (!msg) return;

        // anti-spam simple pour INFO (pas 2 fois la même en <5s)
        if (msg.startsWith("[INFO]")){
          var now = Date.now();
          if (lastInfo.msg === msg && (now - lastInfo.at) < 5000) return;
          lastInfo.msg = msg; lastInfo.at = now;
        }

        var time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
        var node = document.createElement("div");
        node.className = "log-item";
        node.innerHTML = "<span>"+msg+"</span><span>"+time+"</span>";
        el.prepend(node);
        if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
      }catch(e){}
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", install);
  else install();
})();

<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__hermesLogFormatterFinal) return;
  window.__hermesLogFormatterFinal = true;

  function human(n){
    var x = Number(n); if(!isFinite(x)) return (n==null?"":String(n));
    try { return x.toLocaleString("fr-FR",{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:6}); } catch { return String(x); }
  }
  function fmt(p){
    if (!p) return null;
    // On NE préfixe JAMAIS les INFO
    if (p.event === "INFO") return "[INFO] " + (p.info||"");
    if (p.event === "SIM_SIGNAL") return null; // on masque
    var tag = (p.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIMU";
    var sym = p.symbol || p.instId || "";
    var side= (p.side||"").toString().toUpperCase();
    var lev = p.lev ? (" x"+p.lev) : "";
    if (p.event === "TRADE_ENTER") return "["+tag+"] Ouverture "+sym+" – "+side+lev+(p.price!=null?(" – @ "+human(p.price)):"");
    if (p.event === "TRADE_EXIT")  return "["+tag+"] Fermeture "+sym+" – "+side+lev+(p.profit!=null?(" – PNL "+(p.profit>=0?"+":"")+human(p.profit)+" USDT"):"");
    if (p.event === "STOP_BE_NET0") return "["+tag+"] Stop BE (net) "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAIL_ON_LOCK25") return "["+tag+"] Trailing ON & lock +25% "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAIL_RAISE_LOCK25") return "["+tag+"] Trailing rehaussé "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "STOP_PLACED") return "["+tag+"] Stop initial "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "ORDER_REJECT" || p.event === "ORDER_ERR") return "[INFO] Refus/Erreur ordre "+sym+" – "+side+(p.reason?(" : "+p.reason):"");
    if (p.event === "AI_TOGGLE") return "[INFO] Hermes – IA "+(p.on===true?"Activée":"Désactivée");
    return null;
  }
  function getIPC(){
    // bridge window.api
    if (window.api && typeof window.api.on === "function") return { on: window.api.on.bind(window.api) };
    // ipcRenderer global
    if (window.ipcRenderer && typeof window.ipcRenderer.on === "function") return { on: (ch,cb)=>window.ipcRenderer.on(ch,(_e,p)=>cb(p)) };
    // require fallback
    if (typeof require === "function"){ try{
      var el = require("electron"); if (el && el.ipcRenderer && typeof el.ipcRenderer.on === "function")
        return { on: (ch,cb)=>el.ipcRenderer.on(ch,(_e,p)=>cb(p)) };
    }catch(e){} }
    return null;
  }
  function install(){
    var IPC = getIPC(), el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
    if (!IPC || !el){ setTimeout(install,300); return; }
    IPC.on("ai-log", function(p){
      try{
        var msg = fmt(p);
        if (!msg) return;
        var time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
        var node = document.createElement("div");
        node.className = "log-item";
        node.innerHTML = "<span>"+msg+"</span><span>"+time+"</span>";
        el.prepend(node);
        if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
      }catch(e){}
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", install); else install();
})();
</script>
<!-- === END final guard === -->
<!-- === HERMES: LOG SANITIZER (remove [AI-*] [INFO]) === -->
<script>
(function(){
  function cleanText(t){
    // supprime un éventuel préfixe "[AI-LIVE] [INFO]" ou "[AI-SIM] [INFO]"
    return String(t||"").replace(/^\s*\[(AI\-LIVE|AI\-SIM|AI\-SIMU)\]\s*\[INFO\]\s*/i, "[INFO] ");
  }
  function sanitizeOnce(){
    try{
      var el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
      var items = el.querySelectorAll(".log-item > span:first-child");
      for (var i=0;i<items.length;i++){
        var s = items[i]; var txt = s.textContent || s.innerText || "";
        var nt = cleanText(txt);
        if (nt !== txt){ s.textContent = nt; }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function observe(){
    var el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el){ setTimeout(observe, 300); return; }
    // clean à l'init
    sanitizeOnce();
    // clean à chaque ajout
    var mo = new MutationObserver(function(muts){
      for (var m of muts){
        if (m.addedNodes && m.addedNodes.length){
          sanitizeOnce();
        }
      }
    });
    mo.observe(el, { childList:true });
    // et un petit intervalle de secours
    setInterval(sanitizeOnce, 2000);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", observe); else observe();
})();
</script>
<!-- === END SANITIZER === -->
<!-- === HERMES: INFO blank scrubber === -->
<script>
(function(){
  function scrubOnce(){
    try{
      var list = document.querySelectorAll("#logsContent .log-item > span:first-child");
      for (var i=0;i<list.length;i++){
        var t = (list[i].textContent||"").trim();
        if (t === "[INFO]" || t === "[INFO]") {
          var row = list[i].parentElement;
          if (row && row.parentElement) row.parentElement.removeChild(row);
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function observe(){
    var el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
    if (!el) { setTimeout(observe, 300); return; }
    scrubOnce();
    var mo = new MutationObserver(function(m){ scrubOnce(); });
    mo.observe(el, { childList:true });
    setInterval(scrubOnce, 2000);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", observe); else observe();
})();
</script>
<!-- === END === -->

      <div class="table-body" id="tableBody"><div class="loading" style="padding:12px;color:#b8b8b8;">Chargement des données...</div></div>
    </main>
