  <script>
    // ===== Bridge IPC (Electron avec nodeIntegration ou preload) =====
    let ipcRenderer;
    try { ipcRenderer = require("electron").ipcRenderer; } catch { ipcRenderer = null; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.electron && window.electron.ipcRenderer){ ipcRenderer = window.electron.ipcRenderer; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.api && typeof window.api.invoke === "function"){
      ipcRenderer = { invoke: (...args) => window.api.invoke(...args), on: (ch, fn) => window.api.on(ch, fn) };
    }
    if(!ipcRenderer){ console.warn("Electron IPC non disponible (ni nodeIntegration ni preload bridge)."); }

    // ===== Helpers =====
    function formatSymbol(raw){
      if(!raw) return "";
      const s = String(raw).toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-");
      const parts = s.split("-");
      if (parts.length >= 3 && parts[2] === "SWAP") return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}-M`;
      if (parts.length >= 2) return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}`;
      return s;
    }
    function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)); }

    class HermesMonitor{
      constructor(){
        this.data = []; this.portfolioData = null;
        this.startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests = 0; this.successfulRequests = 0;
        this.portfolioRequests = 0; this.portfolioSuccessful = 0;
        this.spotChartCtx = null; this.resizeObserver = null;
        this.toggleBusy = false;
        this.init();
      }

      async init(){
        this.startTimeUpdater(); this.startUptimeUpdater();

        // Premiers fetchs
        await this.fetchData();
        await this.fetchPortfolio();
        await this.refreshAI();

        // Boucles de rafraîchissement
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchData(), 1000);
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchPortfolio(), 3000);
        setInterval(()=>this.refreshAI(), 3000);

        const c = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if (c) this.spotChartCtx = c.getContext("2d");
        this.setupResize();

        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
if (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
    if(this.isViewer || !ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.classList.add("busy");
    try{
      const cur = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      const next = !(cur && cur.active === true);
      await ipcRenderer.invoke("toggle-ai", next);
      const fresh = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      this.renderAI(fresh);
    }catch(e){
      try{
        const el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        if (el) {
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] Toggle: ${e?.message||e}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
          if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
        }
      }catch{}
    }finally{
      btn.classList.remove("busy");
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
}

        // Logs temps réel
if (ipcRenderer?.on) {
  ipcRenderer.on("ai-log", (_e, payload)=>{
    try{
      const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
      let msg;
      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
      if (payload === undefined || payload === null) {
        msg = "(no message)";
      } else if (typeof payload === "string") {
        msg = payload;
      } else {
        const mode = (payload && payload.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIM";
        const ev   = payload?.event ? String(payload.event).toUpperCase() : "LOG";
        const sym  = payload?.instId || "";
        const side = payload?.side ? String(payload.side).toUpperCase() : "";
        const qty  = (payload?.qty!=null) ? `x${payload.qty}` : "";
        const px   = (payload?.price!=null) ? `@ ${payload.price}` : "";
        msg = `[${mode}] [${ev}] ${sym} ${side} ${qty} ${px}`.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");
      }
      const node = document.createElement("div");
      node.className = "log-item";
      node.innerHTML = `<span>${msg}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
      el.prepend(node);
      if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
    }catch{}
  });
}

// Catch erreurs JS
        window.addEventListener("error", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] ${e.message}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
        window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_REJECT] ${e.reason?.message||e.reason||'Promise rejected'}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
      }

      setupResize(){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if(!canvas) return;
        const cb = ()=>{
          canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth; canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
          if (this.portfolioData?.history?.spot) this.drawSpotChart(this.portfolioData.history.spot);
        };
        this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(cb); this.resizeObserver.observe(canvas); cb();
      }

      async refreshAI(){
        try{
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
          const state = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
          this.renderAI(state);
        }catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
      }

      async fetchData(){
        const startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests++;
        try{
          this.updateStatus("loading","Synchronisation...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-data");
          const responseTime = Date.now()-startTime;
          if(result.success){
            this.successfulRequests++;
            this.updateStatus("connected","Connecté OKX");
            const arr = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data.slice(0, 100) : [];
            this.updateUI(arr, responseTime);
            const cc = document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if (cc) cc.textContent = String(arr.length);
          } else { throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-data failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updateStatus("error","Erreur de connexion");
          this.showError(err.message||String(err));
        }
      }

      async fetchPortfolio(){
        this.portfolioRequests++;
        try{
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("loading","Sync Portfolio...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-portfolio");
          if(result.success){
            this.portfolioSuccessful++;
            this.updatePortfolioStatus("connected","Portfolio OKX");
            this.updatePortfolioUI(result.data);
          }else{ throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-portfolio failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("error","Erreur Portfolio");
          console.error("Erreur Portfolio:", err);
        }
      }

      renderAI(state){
        const label = document.getElementById("aiStateLabel");
        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
        const logsEl = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        const active = !!(state && (state.active === true || state.active === "true"));
        if(label){ label.textContent = active ? "Actif" : "Inactif"; label.className = "ai-state " + (active ? "ai-active" : "ai-inactive"); }
        if(btn){ btn.className = "toggle-btn" + (active ? " active" : ""); }
        const html = (state?.logs||[]).slice(-150).reverse().map(l=>{
          const d = new Date(l.ts);
          return `<div class="log-item"><span>${l.message}</span><span>${d.toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
        if(logsEl && !logsEl.dataset.hydrated){
          logsEl.innerHTML = html || "<div class='log-item'><span>Aucun log</span><span>--:--:--</span></div>";
          logsEl.dataset.hydrated = "1";
        }
      }

      updateUI(data, responseTime){
        if(!data || !Array.isArray(data)) return;
        this.data = data; this.renderTable(); this.renderMovers();
        const cc=document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if(cc) cc.textContent=String(this.data.length);
        this.updateStats(responseTime);
      }

      updatePortfolioUI(p){
        if(!p) return; this.portfolioData = p;

        // N4 — Soldes
        const soldeCompte = Number(p.futures?.total ?? 0);
        const usedMargin  = Number(p.positions?.totalMargin ?? 0);
        const disponible  = Math.max(0, soldeCompte - usedMargin);

        document.getElementById("soldeCompte").textContent     = `$${this.formatPrice(soldeCompte)}`;
        document.getElementById("openTradesAmount").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;
        document.getElementById("availableBalance").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(disponible)}`;

        // N5 — Positions
        document.getElementById("openPositions").textContent = p.positions?.count ?? 0;
        document.getElementById("positionsValue").textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(p.positions?.totalValue ?? 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("totalMargin").textContent   = `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;

        const unrealizedPnLEl = document.getElementById("unrealizedPnL");
        const pnlValue = Number(p.futures?.unrealizedPnL || 0);
        unrealizedPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(pnlValue))}`;
        unrealizedPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${pnlValue >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N6 — Performance (+ rendement/min UI)
        const winrateEl = document.getElementById("winrate");
        const winrate = Number(p.performance?.winrate || 0);
        winrateEl.textContent = `${winrate.toFixed(1)}%`;
        winrateEl.className = `metric-value ${winrate >= 50 ? "positive" : winrate >= 30 ? "warning" : "negative"}`;

        const dailyPnLEl = document.getElementById("dailyPnL");
        const dailyPnL = Number(p.performance?.dailyPnL || 0);
        dailyPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(dailyPnL))}`;
        dailyPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${dailyPnL >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        const ypmEl = document.getElementById("yieldPerMin");
        const ypm = this.computeYieldPerMin(p.dealsRecent||[]);
        ypmEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(ypm)}/min`;
        ypmEl.className = `metric-value ${ypm >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N7 — Activité
        document.getElementById("dailyTrades").textContent = p.performance?.dailyTrades || 0;
        document.getElementById("dailyVolume").textContent = `$${this.formatVolume(p.performance?.dailyVolume || 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("lastUpdate").textContent  = new Date(p.lastUpdate||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

        // N5/N10/N9 — Rendus détaillés
        this.renderOpenTrades(p.openPositionsDetails || []);
        this.drawSpotChart(p.history?.spot || []);
        this.renderHistory(p.dealsRecent || []);
      }

      computeYieldPerMin(deals){
        if(!deals || !deals.length) return 0;
        const now = Date.now();
        const last60 = deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 60*60*1000);
        let sample = last60.length ? last60 : deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 24*60*60*1000);
        if(!sample.length) sample = deals;
        const pnl = sample.reduce((a,d)=> a + (Number(d.profit||d.pnl||0)||0), 0);
        const firstTs = Math.min(...sample.map(d=>Number(d.time||now)));
        const mins = Math.max(1, (now - firstTs) / 60000);
        return pnl / mins;
      }

      renderOpenTrades(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#openTradesTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' style='color:#888;'>Aucune position ouverte</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.entryTime || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
          const ur   = Number(r.unrealizedPnl ?? r.upl ?? 0);
          const pnlCls = ur>=0 ? "positive" : "negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${r.side==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${r.side}</span></td>
            <td>${r.leverage? "x"+Number(r.leverage): "-"}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.entryPrice)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(ur)}</td>
            <td>${time}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderHistory(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#historyTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' style='color:#888;'>Aucun trade</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0,300).map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.time||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          const pnl  = Number(r.profit||r.pnl||0);
          const pnlCls = (pnl>=0)?"positive":"negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${time}</td>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()}</span></td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.price)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin||0)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(pnl)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      drawSpotChart(points){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart");
        if(!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
        if(!points || points.length < 2) return;

        const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height, pad = 20;
        const xs = points.map(p=>p.t), ys = points.map(p=>Number(p.v||0));
        const minY = Math.min(...ys), maxY = Math.max(...ys);
        const yPad = (maxY-minY)*0.1 || 1;
        const lo = minY - yPad, hi = maxY + yPad;
        const t0 = xs[0], t1 = xs[xs.length-1] || (t0+1);
        const X = v => pad + ((v - t0) / (t1 - t0 || 1)) * (w - pad*2);
        const Y = v => h - pad - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (h - pad*2);

        // Bords
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f2f2f"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w-pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(w-pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();

        // Ligne
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a9eff";
        points.forEach((p,i)=>{ const x=X(p.t), y=Y(Number(p.v||0)); if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); });
        ctx.stroke();

        // Dernière valeur
        const last = points[points.length-1];
        let lx = Math.min(X(last.t)+6, w - pad - 110);
        let ly = Math.max(Y(Number(last.v||0))-6, pad + 14);
        const text = "$"+this.formatPrice(last.v);
        ctx.font = "12px Monaco, monospace";
        const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + 8, th = 16;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(lx-4, ly-12, tw, th);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#e8e8e8"; ctx.fillText(text, lx, ly);
      }

      renderTable(){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody"); if(!tableBody) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ tableBody.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='padding:12px;color:#b8b8b8;'>En attente de données...</div>"; return; }

        const rows = this.data.slice(0, 100);
        tableBody.innerHTML = rows.map((c, i)=>{
          const price = Number(c.lastPrice)||0;
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100);
          const cls = change>0?"positive":change<0?"negative":"neutral";

          const fundingNum = (typeof c.fundingRate === "number") ? c.fundingRate : null;
          const funding = (fundingNum===null) ? "—" : `${fundingNum>=0?"+":""}${(fundingNum*100).toFixed(4)}%`;
          const fundingCls = (fundingNum===null) ? "neutral" : (fundingNum>0?"positive":fundingNum<0?"negative":"neutral");

          const makerFee = (typeof c.makerFee === "number") ? (c.makerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.makerFee || "—");
          const takerFee = (typeof c.takerFee === "number") ? (c.takerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.takerFee || "—");

          const upd = new Date(c.updatedTs||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

          return `
            <div class="table-row">
              <div class="cell rank">${i+1}</div>
              <div class="cell symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</div>
              <div class="cell price ${cls}">$${this.formatPrice(price)}</div>
              <div class="cell change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(2):"0.00"}%</div>
              <div class="cell volume">${this.formatVolume(c.volume24)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.high24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.low24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell funding ${fundingCls}">${funding}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${makerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${takerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell trend-indicator">${upd}</div>
            </div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderMovers(){
        const moversList = document.getElementById("moversList"); if(!moversList) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ moversList.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='color:#888;'>—</div>"; return; }
        const topMovers = [...this.data].sort((a,b)=> Math.abs(+b.riseFallRate||0) - Math.abs(+a.riseFallRate||0)).slice(0,4);
        moversList.innerHTML = topMovers.map(c=>{
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100); const cls = change>=0?"positive":"negative";
          return `<div class="mover-item"><span class="mover-symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</span><span class="mover-change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(1):"0.0"}%</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      updateStats(responseTime){
        const lat = document.getElementById("latency"); if(lat) lat.textContent = `${responseTime}ms`;
        const sr = document.getElementById("successRate");
        const successRate = this.totalRequests ? (this.successfulRequests / this.totalRequests * 100).toFixed(0) : 0;
        if(sr) sr.textContent = `${successRate}%`;
      }

      updateStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("statusDot"), t = document.getElementById("statusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }
      updatePortfolioStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusDot"), t = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }

      startTimeUpdater(){ setInterval(()=>{ const el = document.getElementById("currentTime"); if(el) el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR"); },1000); }
      startUptimeUpdater(){
        setInterval(()=>{ const u = Date.now()-this.startTime; const h=Math.floor(u/3600000), m=Math.floor((u%3600000)/60000), s=Math.floor((u%60000)/1000);
          const el=document.getElementById("uptime"); if(el) el.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s).padStart(2,"0")}`; },1000);
      }

      showError(message){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
        if(tableBody) tableBody.innerHTML = `<div class="error" style="color:#f87171;text-align:center;padding:20px;">Erreur: ${message}</div>`;
      }

      formatPrice(price){
        const p = parseFloat(price); if(!isFinite(p)) return "0.00";
        if(p < 0.01) return p.toFixed(6);
        if(p < 1) return p.toFixed(4);
        if(p < 100) return p.toFixed(2);
        return p.toFixed(2);
      }
      formatVolume(v){
        const n = parseFloat(v); if(!isFinite(n)) return "0";
        if(n >= 1e9) return (n/1e9).toFixed(1)+"B";
        if(n >= 1e6) return (n/1e6).toFixed(1)+"M";
        if(n >= 1e3) return (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+"K";
        return n.toFixed(0);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ()=>{
      window.hermesMonitor = new HermesMonitor();
    });
  </script>

    // ===== Bridge IPC (Electron avec nodeIntegration ou preload) =====
    let ipcRenderer;
    try { ipcRenderer = require("electron").ipcRenderer; } catch { ipcRenderer = null; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.electron && window.electron.ipcRenderer){ ipcRenderer = window.electron.ipcRenderer; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.api && typeof window.api.invoke === "function"){
      ipcRenderer = { invoke: (...args) => window.api.invoke(...args), on: (ch, fn) => window.api.on(ch, fn) };
    }
    if(!ipcRenderer){ console.warn("Electron IPC non disponible (ni nodeIntegration ni preload bridge)."); }

    // ===== Helpers =====
    function formatSymbol(raw){
      if(!raw) return "";
      const s = String(raw).toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-");
      const parts = s.split("-");
      if (parts.length >= 3 && parts[2] === "SWAP") return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}-M`;
      if (parts.length >= 2) return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}`;
      return s;
    }
    function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)); }

    class HermesMonitor{
      constructor(){
        this.data = []; this.portfolioData = null;
        this.startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests = 0; this.successfulRequests = 0;
        this.portfolioRequests = 0; this.portfolioSuccessful = 0;
        this.spotChartCtx = null; this.resizeObserver = null;
        this.toggleBusy = false;
        this.init();
      }

      async init(){
        this.startTimeUpdater(); this.startUptimeUpdater();

        // Premiers fetchs
        await this.fetchData();
        await this.fetchPortfolio();
        await this.refreshAI();

        // Boucles de rafraîchissement
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchData(), 1000);
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchPortfolio(), 3000);
        setInterval(()=>this.refreshAI(), 3000);

        const c = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if (c) this.spotChartCtx = c.getContext("2d");
        this.setupResize();

        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
if (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
    if(this.isViewer || !ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.classList.add("busy");
    try{
      const cur = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      const next = !(cur && cur.active === true);
      await ipcRenderer.invoke("toggle-ai", next);
      const fresh = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      this.renderAI(fresh);
    }catch(e){
      try{
        const el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        if (el) {
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] Toggle: ${e?.message||e}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
          if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
        }
      }catch{}
    }finally{
      btn.classList.remove("busy");
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
}

        // Logs temps réel
if (ipcRenderer?.on) {
  ipcRenderer.on("ai-log", (_e, payload)=>{
    try{
      const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
      let msg;
      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
      if (payload === undefined || payload === null) {
        msg = "(no message)";
      } else if (typeof payload === "string") {
        msg = payload;
      } else {
        const mode = (payload && payload.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIM";
        const ev   = payload?.event ? String(payload.event).toUpperCase() : "LOG";
        const sym  = payload?.instId || "";
        const side = payload?.side ? String(payload.side).toUpperCase() : "";
        const qty  = (payload?.qty!=null) ? `x${payload.qty}` : "";
        const px   = (payload?.price!=null) ? `@ ${payload.price}` : "";
        msg = `[${mode}] [${ev}] ${sym} ${side} ${qty} ${px}`.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");
      }
      const node = document.createElement("div");
      node.className = "log-item";
      node.innerHTML = `<span>${msg}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
      el.prepend(node);
      if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
    }catch{}
  });
}

// Catch erreurs JS
        window.addEventListener("error", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] ${e.message}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
        window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_REJECT] ${e.reason?.message||e.reason||'Promise rejected'}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
      }

      setupResize(){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if(!canvas) return;
        const cb = ()=>{
          canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth; canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
          if (this.portfolioData?.history?.spot) this.drawSpotChart(this.portfolioData.history.spot);
        };
        this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(cb); this.resizeObserver.observe(canvas); cb();
      }

      async refreshAI(){
        try{
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
          const state = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
          this.renderAI(state);
        }catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
      }

      async fetchData(){
        const startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests++;
        try{
          this.updateStatus("loading","Synchronisation...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-data");
          const responseTime = Date.now()-startTime;
          if(result.success){
            this.successfulRequests++;
            this.updateStatus("connected","Connecté OKX");
            const arr = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data.slice(0, 100) : [];
            this.updateUI(arr, responseTime);
            const cc = document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if (cc) cc.textContent = String(arr.length);
          } else { throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-data failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updateStatus("error","Erreur de connexion");
          this.showError(err.message||String(err));
        }
      }

      async fetchPortfolio(){
        this.portfolioRequests++;
        try{
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("loading","Sync Portfolio...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-portfolio");
          if(result.success){
            this.portfolioSuccessful++;
            this.updatePortfolioStatus("connected","Portfolio OKX");
            this.updatePortfolioUI(result.data);
          }else{ throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-portfolio failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("error","Erreur Portfolio");
          console.error("Erreur Portfolio:", err);
        }
      }

      renderAI(state){
        const label = document.getElementById("aiStateLabel");
        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
        const logsEl = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        const active = !!(state && (state.active === true || state.active === "true"));
        if(label){ label.textContent = active ? "Actif" : "Inactif"; label.className = "ai-state " + (active ? "ai-active" : "ai-inactive"); }
        if(btn){ btn.className = "toggle-btn" + (active ? " active" : ""); }
        const html = (state?.logs||[]).slice(-150).reverse().map(l=>{
          const d = new Date(l.ts);
          return `<div class="log-item"><span>${l.message}</span><span>${d.toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
        if(logsEl && !logsEl.dataset.hydrated){
          logsEl.innerHTML = html || "<div class='log-item'><span>Aucun log</span><span>--:--:--</span></div>";
          logsEl.dataset.hydrated = "1";
        }
      }

      updateUI(data, responseTime){
        if(!data || !Array.isArray(data)) return;
        this.data = data; this.renderTable(); this.renderMovers();
        const cc=document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if(cc) cc.textContent=String(this.data.length);
        this.updateStats(responseTime);
      }

      updatePortfolioUI(p){
        if(!p) return; this.portfolioData = p;

        // N4 — Soldes
        const soldeCompte = Number(p.futures?.total ?? 0);
        const usedMargin  = Number(p.positions?.totalMargin ?? 0);
        const disponible  = Math.max(0, soldeCompte - usedMargin);

        document.getElementById("soldeCompte").textContent     = `$${this.formatPrice(soldeCompte)}`;
        document.getElementById("openTradesAmount").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;
        document.getElementById("availableBalance").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(disponible)}`;

        // N5 — Positions
        document.getElementById("openPositions").textContent = p.positions?.count ?? 0;
        document.getElementById("positionsValue").textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(p.positions?.totalValue ?? 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("totalMargin").textContent   = `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;

        const unrealizedPnLEl = document.getElementById("unrealizedPnL");
        const pnlValue = Number(p.futures?.unrealizedPnL || 0);
        unrealizedPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(pnlValue))}`;
        unrealizedPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${pnlValue >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N6 — Performance (+ rendement/min UI)
        const winrateEl = document.getElementById("winrate");
        const winrate = Number(p.performance?.winrate || 0);
        winrateEl.textContent = `${winrate.toFixed(1)}%`;
        winrateEl.className = `metric-value ${winrate >= 50 ? "positive" : winrate >= 30 ? "warning" : "negative"}`;

        const dailyPnLEl = document.getElementById("dailyPnL");
        const dailyPnL = Number(p.performance?.dailyPnL || 0);
        dailyPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(dailyPnL))}`;
        dailyPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${dailyPnL >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        const ypmEl = document.getElementById("yieldPerMin");
        const ypm = this.computeYieldPerMin(p.dealsRecent||[]);
        ypmEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(ypm)}/min`;
        ypmEl.className = `metric-value ${ypm >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N7 — Activité
        document.getElementById("dailyTrades").textContent = p.performance?.dailyTrades || 0;
        document.getElementById("dailyVolume").textContent = `$${this.formatVolume(p.performance?.dailyVolume || 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("lastUpdate").textContent  = new Date(p.lastUpdate||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

        // N5/N10/N9 — Rendus détaillés
        this.renderOpenTrades(p.openPositionsDetails || []);
        this.drawSpotChart(p.history?.spot || []);
        this.renderHistory(p.dealsRecent || []);
      }

      computeYieldPerMin(deals){
        if(!deals || !deals.length) return 0;
        const now = Date.now();
        const last60 = deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 60*60*1000);
        let sample = last60.length ? last60 : deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 24*60*60*1000);
        if(!sample.length) sample = deals;
        const pnl = sample.reduce((a,d)=> a + (Number(d.profit||d.pnl||0)||0), 0);
        const firstTs = Math.min(...sample.map(d=>Number(d.time||now)));
        const mins = Math.max(1, (now - firstTs) / 60000);
        return pnl / mins;
      }

      renderOpenTrades(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#openTradesTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' style='color:#888;'>Aucune position ouverte</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.entryTime || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
          const ur   = Number(r.unrealizedPnl ?? r.upl ?? 0);
          const pnlCls = ur>=0 ? "positive" : "negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${r.side==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${r.side}</span></td>
            <td>${r.leverage? "x"+Number(r.leverage): "-"}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.entryPrice)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(ur)}</td>
            <td>${time}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderHistory(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#historyTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' style='color:#888;'>Aucun trade</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0,300).map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.time||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          const pnl  = Number(r.profit||r.pnl||0);
          const pnlCls = (pnl>=0)?"positive":"negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${time}</td>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()}</span></td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.price)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin||0)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(pnl)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      drawSpotChart(points){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart");
        if(!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
        if(!points || points.length < 2) return;

        const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height, pad = 20;
        const xs = points.map(p=>p.t), ys = points.map(p=>Number(p.v||0));
        const minY = Math.min(...ys), maxY = Math.max(...ys);
        const yPad = (maxY-minY)*0.1 || 1;
        const lo = minY - yPad, hi = maxY + yPad;
        const t0 = xs[0], t1 = xs[xs.length-1] || (t0+1);
        const X = v => pad + ((v - t0) / (t1 - t0 || 1)) * (w - pad*2);
        const Y = v => h - pad - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (h - pad*2);

        // Bords
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f2f2f"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w-pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(w-pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();

        // Ligne
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a9eff";
        points.forEach((p,i)=>{ const x=X(p.t), y=Y(Number(p.v||0)); if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); });
        ctx.stroke();

        // Dernière valeur
        const last = points[points.length-1];
        let lx = Math.min(X(last.t)+6, w - pad - 110);
        let ly = Math.max(Y(Number(last.v||0))-6, pad + 14);
        const text = "$"+this.formatPrice(last.v);
        ctx.font = "12px Monaco, monospace";
        const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + 8, th = 16;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(lx-4, ly-12, tw, th);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#e8e8e8"; ctx.fillText(text, lx, ly);
      }

      renderTable(){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody"); if(!tableBody) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ tableBody.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='padding:12px;color:#b8b8b8;'>En attente de données...</div>"; return; }

        const rows = this.data.slice(0, 100);
        tableBody.innerHTML = rows.map((c, i)=>{
          const price = Number(c.lastPrice)||0;
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100);
          const cls = change>0?"positive":change<0?"negative":"neutral";

          const fundingNum = (typeof c.fundingRate === "number") ? c.fundingRate : null;
          const funding = (fundingNum===null) ? "—" : `${fundingNum>=0?"+":""}${(fundingNum*100).toFixed(4)}%`;
          const fundingCls = (fundingNum===null) ? "neutral" : (fundingNum>0?"positive":fundingNum<0?"negative":"neutral");

          const makerFee = (typeof c.makerFee === "number") ? (c.makerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.makerFee || "—");
          const takerFee = (typeof c.takerFee === "number") ? (c.takerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.takerFee || "—");

          const upd = new Date(c.updatedTs||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

          return `
            <div class="table-row">
              <div class="cell rank">${i+1}</div>
              <div class="cell symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</div>
              <div class="cell price ${cls}">$${this.formatPrice(price)}</div>
              <div class="cell change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(2):"0.00"}%</div>
              <div class="cell volume">${this.formatVolume(c.volume24)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.high24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.low24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell funding ${fundingCls}">${funding}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${makerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${takerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell trend-indicator">${upd}</div>
            </div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderMovers(){
        const moversList = document.getElementById("moversList"); if(!moversList) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ moversList.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='color:#888;'>—</div>"; return; }
        const topMovers = [...this.data].sort((a,b)=> Math.abs(+b.riseFallRate||0) - Math.abs(+a.riseFallRate||0)).slice(0,4);
        moversList.innerHTML = topMovers.map(c=>{
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100); const cls = change>=0?"positive":"negative";
          return `<div class="mover-item"><span class="mover-symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</span><span class="mover-change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(1):"0.0"}%</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      updateStats(responseTime){
        const lat = document.getElementById("latency"); if(lat) lat.textContent = `${responseTime}ms`;
        const sr = document.getElementById("successRate");
        const successRate = this.totalRequests ? (this.successfulRequests / this.totalRequests * 100).toFixed(0) : 0;
        if(sr) sr.textContent = `${successRate}%`;
      }

      updateStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("statusDot"), t = document.getElementById("statusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }
      updatePortfolioStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusDot"), t = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }

      startTimeUpdater(){ setInterval(()=>{ const el = document.getElementById("currentTime"); if(el) el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR"); },1000); }
      startUptimeUpdater(){
        setInterval(()=>{ const u = Date.now()-this.startTime; const h=Math.floor(u/3600000), m=Math.floor((u%3600000)/60000), s=Math.floor((u%60000)/1000);
          const el=document.getElementById("uptime"); if(el) el.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s).padStart(2,"0")}`; },1000);
      }

      showError(message){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
        if(tableBody) tableBody.innerHTML = `<div class="error" style="color:#f87171;text-align:center;padding:20px;">Erreur: ${message}</div>`;
      }

      formatPrice(price){
        const p = parseFloat(price); if(!isFinite(p)) return "0.00";
        if(p < 0.01) return p.toFixed(6);
        if(p < 1) return p.toFixed(4);
        if(p < 100) return p.toFixed(2);
        return p.toFixed(2);
      }
      formatVolume(v){
        const n = parseFloat(v); if(!isFinite(n)) return "0";
        if(n >= 1e9) return (n/1e9).toFixed(1)+"B";
        if(n >= 1e6) return (n/1e6).toFixed(1)+"M";
        if(n >= 1e3) return (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+"K";
        return n.toFixed(0);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ()=>{
      window.hermesMonitor = new HermesMonitor();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    // ===== Bridge IPC (Electron avec nodeIntegration ou preload) =====
    let ipcRenderer;
    try { ipcRenderer = require("electron").ipcRenderer; } catch { ipcRenderer = null; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.electron && window.electron.ipcRenderer){ ipcRenderer = window.electron.ipcRenderer; }
    if(!ipcRenderer && window.api && typeof window.api.invoke === "function"){
      ipcRenderer = { invoke: (...args) => window.api.invoke(...args), on: (ch, fn) => window.api.on(ch, fn) };
    }
    if(!ipcRenderer){ console.warn("Electron IPC non disponible (ni nodeIntegration ni preload bridge)."); }

    // ===== Helpers =====
    function formatSymbol(raw){
      if(!raw) return "";
      const s = String(raw).toUpperCase().replaceAll("_","-");
      const parts = s.split("-");
      if (parts.length >= 3 && parts[2] === "SWAP") return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}-M`;
      if (parts.length >= 2) return `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}`;
      return s;
    }
    function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)); }

    class HermesMonitor{
      constructor(){
        this.data = []; this.portfolioData = null;
        this.startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests = 0; this.successfulRequests = 0;
        this.portfolioRequests = 0; this.portfolioSuccessful = 0;
        this.spotChartCtx = null; this.resizeObserver = null;
        this.toggleBusy = false;
        this.init();
      }

      async init(){
        this.startTimeUpdater(); this.startUptimeUpdater();

        // Premiers fetchs
        await this.fetchData();
        await this.fetchPortfolio();
        await this.refreshAI();

        // Boucles de rafraîchissement
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchData(), 1000);
        setInterval(()=>this.fetchPortfolio(), 3000);
        setInterval(()=>this.refreshAI(), 3000);

        const c = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if (c) this.spotChartCtx = c.getContext("2d");
        this.setupResize();

        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
if (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
    if(this.isViewer || !ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.classList.add("busy");
    try{
      const cur = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      const next = !(cur && cur.active === true);
      await ipcRenderer.invoke("toggle-ai", next);
      const fresh = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
      this.renderAI(fresh);
    }catch(e){
      try{
        const el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        if (el) {
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] Toggle: ${e?.message||e}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
          if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
        }
      }catch{}
    }finally{
      btn.classList.remove("busy");
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
}

        // Logs temps réel
if (ipcRenderer?.on) {
  ipcRenderer.on("ai-log", (_e, payload)=>{
    try{
      const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
      let msg;
      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
      if (payload === undefined || payload === null) {
        msg = "(no message)";
      } else if (typeof payload === "string") {
        msg = payload;
      } else {
        const mode = (payload && payload.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIM";
        const ev   = payload?.event ? String(payload.event).toUpperCase() : "LOG";
        const sym  = payload?.instId || "";
        const side = payload?.side ? String(payload.side).toUpperCase() : "";
        const qty  = (payload?.qty!=null) ? `x${payload.qty}` : "";
        const px   = (payload?.price!=null) ? `@ ${payload.price}` : "";
        msg = `[${mode}] [${ev}] ${sym} ${side} ${qty} ${px}`.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");
      }
      const node = document.createElement("div");
      node.className = "log-item";
      node.innerHTML = `<span>${msg}</span><span>${time}</span>`;
      el.prepend(node);
      if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
    }catch{}
  });
}

// Catch erreurs JS
        window.addEventListener("error", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_ERR] ${e.message}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
        window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e)=>{
          const el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = "log-item";
          node.innerHTML = `<span>[UI_REJECT] ${e.reason?.message||e.reason||'Promise rejected'}</span><span>${new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span>`;
          el.prepend(node);
        });
      }

      setupResize(){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart"); if(!canvas) return;
        const cb = ()=>{
          canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth; canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
          if (this.portfolioData?.history?.spot) this.drawSpotChart(this.portfolioData.history.spot);
        };
        this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(cb); this.resizeObserver.observe(canvas); cb();
      }

      async refreshAI(){
        try{
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) return;
          const state = await ipcRenderer.invoke("get-ai-state");
          this.renderAI(state);
        }catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
      }

      async fetchData(){
        const startTime = Date.now(); this.totalRequests++;
        try{
          this.updateStatus("loading","Synchronisation...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-data");
          const responseTime = Date.now()-startTime;
          if(result.success){
            this.successfulRequests++;
            this.updateStatus("connected","Connecté OKX");
            const arr = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data.slice(0, 100) : [];
            this.updateUI(arr, responseTime);
            const cc = document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if (cc) cc.textContent = String(arr.length);
          } else { throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-data failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updateStatus("error","Erreur de connexion");
          this.showError(err.message||String(err));
        }
      }

      async fetchPortfolio(){
        this.portfolioRequests++;
        try{
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("loading","Sync Portfolio...");
          if(!ipcRenderer?.invoke) throw new Error("IPC indisponible");
          const result = await ipcRenderer.invoke("fetch-portfolio");
          if(result.success){
            this.portfolioSuccessful++;
            this.updatePortfolioStatus("connected","Portfolio OKX");
            this.updatePortfolioUI(result.data);
          }else{ throw new Error(result.error||"fetch-portfolio failed"); }
        }catch(err){
          this.updatePortfolioStatus("error","Erreur Portfolio");
          console.error("Erreur Portfolio:", err);
        }
      }

      renderAI(state){
        const label = document.getElementById("aiStateLabel");
        const btn = document.getElementById("aiToggleBtn");
        const logsEl = document.getElementById("logsContent");
        const active = !!(state && (state.active === true || state.active === "true"));
        if(label){ label.textContent = active ? "Actif" : "Inactif"; label.className = "ai-state " + (active ? "ai-active" : "ai-inactive"); }
        if(btn){ btn.className = "toggle-btn" + (active ? " active" : ""); }
        const html = (state?.logs||[]).slice(-150).reverse().map(l=>{
          const d = new Date(l.ts);
          return `<div class="log-item"><span>${l.message}</span><span>${d.toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})}</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
        if(logsEl && !logsEl.dataset.hydrated){
          logsEl.innerHTML = html || "<div class='log-item'><span>Aucun log</span><span>--:--:--</span></div>";
          logsEl.dataset.hydrated = "1";
        }
      }

      updateUI(data, responseTime){
        if(!data || !Array.isArray(data)) return;
        this.data = data; this.renderTable(); this.renderMovers();
        const cc=document.getElementById("cryptosCount"); if(cc) cc.textContent=String(this.data.length);
        this.updateStats(responseTime);
      }

      updatePortfolioUI(p){
        if(!p) return; this.portfolioData = p;

        // N4 — Soldes
        const soldeCompte = Number(p.futures?.total ?? 0);
        const usedMargin  = Number(p.positions?.totalMargin ?? 0);
        const disponible  = Math.max(0, soldeCompte - usedMargin);

        document.getElementById("soldeCompte").textContent     = `$${this.formatPrice(soldeCompte)}`;
        document.getElementById("openTradesAmount").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;
        document.getElementById("availableBalance").textContent= `$${this.formatPrice(disponible)}`;

        // N5 — Positions
        document.getElementById("openPositions").textContent = p.positions?.count ?? 0;
        document.getElementById("positionsValue").textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(p.positions?.totalValue ?? 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("totalMargin").textContent   = `$${this.formatPrice(usedMargin)}`;

        const unrealizedPnLEl = document.getElementById("unrealizedPnL");
        const pnlValue = Number(p.futures?.unrealizedPnL || 0);
        unrealizedPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(pnlValue))}`;
        unrealizedPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${pnlValue >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N6 — Performance (+ rendement/min UI)
        const winrateEl = document.getElementById("winrate");
        const winrate = Number(p.performance?.winrate || 0);
        winrateEl.textContent = `${winrate.toFixed(1)}%`;
        winrateEl.className = `metric-value ${winrate >= 50 ? "positive" : winrate >= 30 ? "warning" : "negative"}`;

        const dailyPnLEl = document.getElementById("dailyPnL");
        const dailyPnL = Number(p.performance?.dailyPnL || 0);
        dailyPnLEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(Math.abs(dailyPnL))}`;
        dailyPnLEl.className = `metric-value ${dailyPnL >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        const ypmEl = document.getElementById("yieldPerMin");
        const ypm = this.computeYieldPerMin(p.dealsRecent||[]);
        ypmEl.textContent = `$${this.formatPrice(ypm)}/min`;
        ypmEl.className = `metric-value ${ypm >= 0 ? "positive" : "negative"}`;

        // N7 — Activité
        document.getElementById("dailyTrades").textContent = p.performance?.dailyTrades || 0;
        document.getElementById("dailyVolume").textContent = `$${this.formatVolume(p.performance?.dailyVolume || 0)}`;
        document.getElementById("lastUpdate").textContent  = new Date(p.lastUpdate||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

        // N5/N10/N9 — Rendus détaillés
        this.renderOpenTrades(p.openPositionsDetails || []);
        this.drawSpotChart(p.history?.spot || []);
        this.renderHistory(p.dealsRecent || []);
      }

      computeYieldPerMin(deals){
        if(!deals || !deals.length) return 0;
        const now = Date.now();
        const last60 = deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 60*60*1000);
        let sample = last60.length ? last60 : deals.filter(d => (now - Number(d.time||0)) <= 24*60*60*1000);
        if(!sample.length) sample = deals;
        const pnl = sample.reduce((a,d)=> a + (Number(d.profit||d.pnl||0)||0), 0);
        const firstTs = Math.min(...sample.map(d=>Number(d.time||now)));
        const mins = Math.max(1, (now - firstTs) / 60000);
        return pnl / mins;
      }

      renderOpenTrades(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#openTradesTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' style='color:#888;'>Aucune position ouverte</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.entryTime || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
          const ur   = Number(r.unrealizedPnl ?? r.upl ?? 0);
          const pnlCls = ur>=0 ? "positive" : "negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${r.side==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${r.side}</span></td>
            <td>${r.leverage? "x"+Number(r.leverage): "-"}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.entryPrice)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(ur)}</td>
            <td>${time}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderHistory(rows){
        const tbody = document.querySelector("#historyTable tbody"); if(!tbody) return;
        if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' style='color:#888;'>Aucun trade</td></tr>"; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0,300).map(r=>{
          const time = new Date(r.time||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
          const pnl  = Number(r.profit||r.pnl||0);
          const pnlCls = (pnl>=0)?"positive":"negative";
          return `<tr>
            <td>${time}</td>
            <td>${formatSymbol(r.symbol)}</td>
            <td><span class="tag ${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()==="LONG"?"long":"short"}">${String(r.side||"").toUpperCase()}</span></td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.price)}</td>
            <td>$${this.formatPrice(r.margin||0)}</td>
            <td class="price ${pnlCls}">$${this.formatPrice(pnl)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      drawSpotChart(points){
        const canvas = document.getElementById("spotChart");
        if(!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
        if(!points || points.length < 2) return;

        const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height, pad = 20;
        const xs = points.map(p=>p.t), ys = points.map(p=>Number(p.v||0));
        const minY = Math.min(...ys), maxY = Math.max(...ys);
        const yPad = (maxY-minY)*0.1 || 1;
        const lo = minY - yPad, hi = maxY + yPad;
        const t0 = xs[0], t1 = xs[xs.length-1] || (t0+1);
        const X = v => pad + ((v - t0) / (t1 - t0 || 1)) * (w - pad*2);
        const Y = v => h - pad - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (h - pad*2);

        // Bords
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f2f2f"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w-pad, pad); ctx.lineTo(w-pad, h-pad); ctx.stroke();

        // Ligne
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a9eff";
        points.forEach((p,i)=>{ const x=X(p.t), y=Y(Number(p.v||0)); if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); });
        ctx.stroke();

        // Dernière valeur
        const last = points[points.length-1];
        let lx = Math.min(X(last.t)+6, w - pad - 110);
        let ly = Math.max(Y(Number(last.v||0))-6, pad + 14);
        const text = "$"+this.formatPrice(last.v);
        ctx.font = "12px Monaco, monospace";
        const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + 8, th = 16;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(lx-4, ly-12, tw, th);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#e8e8e8"; ctx.fillText(text, lx, ly);
      }

      renderTable(){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody"); if(!tableBody) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ tableBody.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='padding:12px;color:#b8b8b8;'>En attente de données...</div>"; return; }

        const rows = this.data.slice(0, 100);
        tableBody.innerHTML = rows.map((c, i)=>{
          const price = Number(c.lastPrice)||0;
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100);
          const cls = change>0?"positive":change<0?"negative":"neutral";

          const fundingNum = (typeof c.fundingRate === "number") ? c.fundingRate : null;
          const funding = (fundingNum===null) ? "—" : `${fundingNum>=0?"+":""}${(fundingNum*100).toFixed(4)}%`;
          const fundingCls = (fundingNum===null) ? "neutral" : (fundingNum>0?"positive":fundingNum<0?"negative":"neutral");

          const makerFee = (typeof c.makerFee === "number") ? (c.makerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.makerFee || "—");
          const takerFee = (typeof c.takerFee === "number") ? (c.takerFee*100).toFixed(3)+"%" : (c.takerFee || "—");

          const upd = new Date(c.updatedTs||Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});

          return `
            <div class="table-row">
              <div class="cell rank">${i+1}</div>
              <div class="cell symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</div>
              <div class="cell price ${cls}">$${this.formatPrice(price)}</div>
              <div class="cell change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(2):"0.00"}%</div>
              <div class="cell volume">${this.formatVolume(c.volume24)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.high24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell price">$${this.formatPrice(c.low24Price)}</div>
              <div class="cell funding ${fundingCls}">${funding}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${makerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell fee">${takerFee}</div>
              <div class="cell trend-indicator">${upd}</div>
            </div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      renderMovers(){
        const moversList = document.getElementById("moversList"); if(!moversList) return;
        if(!this.data.length){ moversList.innerHTML = "<div class='loading' style='color:#888;'>—</div>"; return; }
        const topMovers = [...this.data].sort((a,b)=> Math.abs(+b.riseFallRate||0) - Math.abs(+a.riseFallRate||0)).slice(0,4);
        moversList.innerHTML = topMovers.map(c=>{
          const change = parseFloat((Number(c.riseFallRate)||0) * 100); const cls = change>=0?"positive":"negative";
          return `<div class="mover-item"><span class="mover-symbol">${formatSymbol(c.symbol)}</span><span class="mover-change ${cls}">${change>=0?"+":""}${isFinite(change)?change.toFixed(1):"0.0"}%</span></div>`;
        }).join("");
      }

      updateStats(responseTime){
        const lat = document.getElementById("latency"); if(lat) lat.textContent = `${responseTime}ms`;
        const sr = document.getElementById("successRate");
        const successRate = this.totalRequests ? (this.successfulRequests / this.totalRequests * 100).toFixed(0) : 0;
        if(sr) sr.textContent = `${successRate}%`;
      }

      updateStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("statusDot"), t = document.getElementById("statusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }
      updatePortfolioStatus(status,text){
        const dot = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusDot"), t = document.getElementById("portfolioStatusText");
        if(dot) dot.className = `status-dot ${status==="error"?"error":""}`;
        if(t) t.textContent = text;
      }

      startTimeUpdater(){ setInterval(()=>{ const el = document.getElementById("currentTime"); if(el) el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR"); },1000); }
      startUptimeUpdater(){
        setInterval(()=>{ const u = Date.now()-this.startTime; const h=Math.floor(u/3600000), m=Math.floor((u%3600000)/60000), s=Math.floor((u%60000)/1000);
          const el=document.getElementById("uptime"); if(el) el.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s).padStart(2,"0")}`; },1000);
      }

      showError(message){
        const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
        if(tableBody) tableBody.innerHTML = `<div class="error" style="color:#f87171;text-align:center;padding:20px;">Erreur: ${message}</div>`;
      }

      formatPrice(price){
        const p = parseFloat(price); if(!isFinite(p)) return "0.00";
        if(p < 0.01) return p.toFixed(6);
        if(p < 1) return p.toFixed(4);
        if(p < 100) return p.toFixed(2);
        return p.toFixed(2);
      }
      formatVolume(v){
        const n = parseFloat(v); if(!isFinite(n)) return "0";
        if(n >= 1e9) return (n/1e9).toFixed(1)+"B";
        if(n >= 1e6) return (n/1e6).toFixed(1)+"M";
        if(n >= 1e3) return (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+"K";
        return n.toFixed(0);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ()=>{
      window.hermesMonitor = new HermesMonitor();
    });
  </script>
</body>

<!-- === HERMES LOG FORMATTER (append, robust) === -->
<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__hermesLogFormatterInstalled) return;
  window.__hermesLogFormatterInstalled = true;

  function human(n){
    var x = Number(n);
    if(!isFinite(x)) return (n==null?"":String(n));
    try { return x.toLocaleString("fr-FR",{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:6}); }
    catch { return String(x); }
  }

  function fmt(p){
    if (!p) return null;
    if (p.event === "SIM_SIGNAL") return null; // on masque la SIM brute
    if (p.event === "INFO") return "[INFO] " + (p.info||"");
    var tag = (p.live===true) ? "AI-LIVE" : "AI-SIMU";
    var sym = p.symbol || p.instId || "";
    var side= (p.side||"").toString().toUpperCase();
    var lev = p.lev ? (" x"+p.lev) : "";
    if (p.event === "TRADE_ENTER") return "["+tag+"] Ouverture "+sym+" – "+side+lev+(p.price!=null?(" – @ "+human(p.price)):"");
    if (p.event === "TRADE_EXIT")  return "["+tag+"] Fermeture "+sym+" – "+side+lev+(p.profit!=null?(" – PNL "+(p.profit>=0?"+":"")+human(p.profit)+" USDT"):"");
    if (p.event === "STOP_BE_NET0") return "["+tag+"] Stop BE (net) "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAIL_ON_LOCK25") return "["+tag+"] Trailing ON & lock +25% "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAIL_RAISE_LOCK25") return "["+tag+"] Trailing rehaussé "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "STOP_PLACED") return "["+tag+"] Stop initial "+sym+" – "+side;
    if (p.event === "TRAINER_TICK") return "[INFO] Mise à jour modèle"+(p.samples!=null?(" (samples "+p.samples+")"):"");
    if (p.event === "ORDER_REJECT" || p.event === "ORDER_ERR") return "[INFO] Refus/Erreur ordre "+sym+" – "+side+(p.reason?(" : "+p.reason):"");
    if (p.event === "AI_TOGGLE") return "[INFO] Hermes – IA "+(p.on===true?"Activée":"Désactivée");
    return null;
  }

  function getIPC(){
    try{
      // Préférence: bridge preload (window.api)
      if (window.api && typeof window.api.on === "function") {
        return { on: window.api.on.bind(window.api) };
      }
      // Fallback: variable globale ipcRenderer déjà créée dans index.html
      if (window.ipcRenderer && typeof window.ipcRenderer.on === "function") {
        return { on: function(ch, cb){ try{ window.ipcRenderer.on(ch, function(_e, payload){ cb(payload); }); }catch(e){} } };
      }
      // Fallback require('electron') si dispo
      if (typeof require === "function") {
        try{
          var electron = require("electron");
          if (electron && electron.ipcRenderer && typeof electron.ipcRenderer.on === "function") {
            return { on: function(ch, cb){ electron.ipcRenderer.on(ch, function(_e, payload){ cb(payload); }); } };
          }
        }catch(e){}
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  }

  function install(){
    var IPC = getIPC();
    var el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
    if (!IPC || !el) { setTimeout(install, 300); return; }

    var lastInfo = { msg:"", at:0 };
    IPC.on("ai-log", function(payload){
      try{
        var msg = fmt(payload);
        if (!msg) return;

        // anti-spam simple pour INFO (pas 2 fois la même en <5s)
        if (msg.startsWith("[INFO]")){
          var now = Date.now();
          if (lastInfo.msg === msg && (now - lastInfo.at) < 5000) return;
          lastInfo.msg = msg; lastInfo.at = now;
        }

        var time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("fr-FR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"});
        var node = document.createElement("div");
        node.className = "log-item";
        node.innerHTML = "<span>"+msg+"</span><span>"+time+"</span>";
        el.prepend(node);
        if (el.children.length > 500) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
      }catch(e){}
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", install);
  else install();
})();
</script>
<!-- === END LOG FORMATTER === -->

  function guard(){
    try{
      var el = document.getElementById("logsContent");
      if (!el) { setTimeout(guard, 300); return; }
      // Empêche le bloc renderAI initial de remplir depuis ai-logs.jsonl en vieux format

      // Optionnel: vider ce qui aurait été injecté avant
      el.innerHTML = "";
      // Message doux (optionnel)

(function(){
  function unhook(){
    try{
      if (window.ipcRenderer && typeof window.ipcRenderer.removeAllListeners === "function"){
        window.ipcRenderer.removeAllListeners("ai-log");
      }
      if (typeof require === "function"){
        try{

          if (electron && electron.ipcRenderer && typeof electron.ipcRenderer.removeAllListeners === "function"){
            electron.ipcRenderer.removeAllListeners("ai-log");
          }
        }catch(e){}
      }
      if (window.api && typeof window.api.removeAll === "function"){
        try{ window.api.removeAll("ai-log"); }catch(e){}
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", unhook);
  else unhook();
})();

<!-- === HERMES: LOG SANITIZER (remove [AI-*] [INFO]) === -->
<script>
(function(){
  function cleanText(t){
    // supprime un éventuel préfixe "[AI-LIVE] [INFO]" ou "[AI-SIM] [INFO]"
    return String(t||"").replace(/^\s*\[(AI\-LIVE|AI\-SIM|AI\-SIMU)\]\s*\[INFO\]\s*/i, "[INFO] ");
  }
  function sanitizeOnce(){
    try{
      var el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el) return;
      var items = el.querySelectorAll(".log-item > span:first-child");
      for (var i=0;i<items.length;i++){
        var s = items[i]; var txt = s.textContent || s.innerText || "";
        var nt = cleanText(txt);
        if (nt !== txt){ s.textContent = nt; }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function observe(){
    var el = document.getElementById("logsContent"); if(!el){ setTimeout(observe, 300); return; }
    // clean à l'init
    sanitizeOnce();
    // clean à chaque ajout
    var mo = new MutationObserver(function(muts){
      for (var m of muts){
        if (m.addedNodes && m.addedNodes.length){
          sanitizeOnce();
        }
      }
    });
    mo.observe(el, { childList:true });
    // et un petit intervalle de secours
    setInterval(sanitizeOnce, 2000);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", observe); else observe();
})();
</script>
<!-- === END SANITIZER === -->
